Meet Dolores!  Delores is a lovely girl with a big heart and plenty of love to give.  This affectionate lady absolutely adores attention and loves nothing more than a good fuss.  If you’re looking for a companion wo will happily climb onto your lap for cuddles, Delores could be the girl for you!  She loves saying hello to everyone she meets and is always keen to make new friends.  She’s a friendly, people-loving girl who enjoys being around her humans and soaking up all the attention she can get.  Like all of us, Delores has a few things she’ll need some help with.  When staff are cleaning her kennel, she can become over excited and will chase and bite the shovel, so she’ll need patient guidance and positive training to help her learn calmer behaviours.  She also currently toilets in her bed, so she will need support with her toilet training and a consistent routine in her new home.  Delores is looking for a loving, understanding family who will see her potential, give her time to settle in and help her learn.  In return, you can expect plenty of affection, lots of fuss and a girl who will be more than happy to snuggle up close to you.  She would benefit from a private secure garden so she can safely have some off-lead time outside.

Delores has interacted with other dogs while in our care, and although she is happy to walk along-side them she doesn’t like them sniffing her back end or getting in her face, so we feel she would be happiest being rehomed as the only dog in the home.

As Delores came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on her so would prefer any children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Murphy
description:
Meet Murphy (17kg).  Murphy is a lovely, friendly boy with a big heart and an even bigger love for people!  He is an incredibly affectionate, people-oriented lad who absolutely thrives on human attention.  The more fuss, cuddles and affection he can get, the happier he is.  He loves spending time with his people and would make a wonderful companion for someone who enjoys long walks and adventures and enjoys having a four-legged friend by their side.  Murphy is still very much a big puppy at heart.  He’s a giddy excitable boy who can get rather carried away with his enthusiasm, and he does tend to jump up when greeting people.  He is full of life, love and energy, so he will need an adopter who can help him channel all that excitement positively and continue working on his manners.  One of Murphy’s favourite things is having off-lead time in our secure compound where he can chase about, have a good sniff and enjoy himself.  He is looking for a very active home where he can enjoy lots of long walks, exciting adventures and plenty of opportunities to burn off his energy.  But it’s not just exercise that Murphy needs.  This clever, lively boy will also benefit from lots of mental stimulation, interactive games and activities to keep his busy mind occupied.  He would absolutely love a home where someone is around for most of the day to give him attention, companionship and the engagement he craves.  Murphy’s ideal home would be – An active family who enjoys long walks and outdoor adventures.  A home committed to providing mental enrichment, interactive play and continued training. Previous experience of the breed/s would be an advantage.  Murphy has so much love to give and will bring plenty of fun, laughter and affection into the right home.  He is looking for someone who will enjoy his lively personality, meet his exercise and stimulation needs, and give him all the love an fuss his heart desires.  He will need a private secure garden.

Murphy has interacted with other dogs while in our care, and although he is happy to walk alongside them he doesn’t like them in his face, so he would be happiest being rehomed as the only dog in the home.

As Murphy came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Theo
description:
Meet Theo! Theo has a big heart and plenty of love to give.  This friendly, affectionate boy absolutely thrives on attention, and the more fuss and cuddles he gets, the happier he is!  Theo loves getting out and about on walks (he does walk better on a harness) but his favourite time of days is his off-lead time in our secure compound where he can run around and chase his favourite toys.  He does know some basic commands like sit, paw and speak and is very eager to please.  Theo can bark to get your attention and tends to jump up when he gets excited.  He will benefit from a family who can continue working with him on his manners and help him learn calmer ways to ask for attention.  Theo is a fun-loving affectionate boy who has so much love to give.  He would love a home where he can enjoy his walks, have plenty of playtime and, most importantly, receive all the love and attention he deserves.  Theo will need a private secure garden so he can safely have off-lead time with his toys.

Theo has socialised with other dogs while in our care, he will have a quick sniff but isn’t too bothered about them, so we feel he would be happiest being the only dog in the home where he can receive 100% of the attention and cuddles.

Theo has a Grade 1 Heart Murmur, this will be discussed in more detail with the successful applicant.

As Theo came into us as a stray we have no previous history on him, so would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Frank
description:
Frank is a sweet-natured boy who absolutely loves people and enjoys being the centre of attention.  He is a very giddy and excitable character, and his enthusiasm can sometimes get the better of him!  Frank loves treats and is always keen to show off what he knows.  He has his basic commands and is eager to learn, especially when there’s a tasty reward involved.  He can be quite vocal in his kennel, and when excited he can become a little mouthy.  He also loves attention and will jump up to say hello, so his new adopter will need to be comfortable helping him learn some calmer ways to greet people.

Frank is a strong boy on the lead and will need continued training and guidance with his lead manners.  He is an active dog who needs plenty of exercise as well as mental stimulation to keep his busy mind occupied.  Frank is looking for an active and committed home where his new family can give him the exercise, enrichment, training and attention he needs.  His ideal home will be one where his adopters understand that he is an excitable, energetic boy and are prepared to work with him on his manners and impulse control.  In return, Frank has so much affection and enthusiasm to give.  He will need a private secure garden.

We think that Frank can be rehomed with dog savvy children who are 16 years and over due to his size and strength – subject to a successful meet.

Frank has interacted well with dogs whilst in our care so we feel that he could potentially be rehomed with another dog of a similar size and temperament – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Jax
description:
Jax is a friendly and affectionate boy who absolutely loves attention and enjoys a good fuss.  He has a wonderful nature and is always happy to spend time with his people. This clever lad is exceptionally well behaved at the vets, taking examinations and handling in his stride, which is a testament to his temperament and trainability.  Like many dogs, he has his own little quirks – one of his favourites is enthusiastically ragging his blankets and rearranging them to his liking!

As a typical Belgian Malinois, he is highly intelligent, energetic and thrives on both physical exercise and mental stimulation.  He loves charging around our compound and would be happiest in a home where he has plenty of opportunities to stay active and engaged.  Jax is very ball focused which is a bonus when it comes to training. Because of his breed traits, he will need an owner who has previous experience with Belgian Malinois and understands their needs.  He is not a dog that will be content with a short walk around the block, he requires ongoing training, enrichment and a lifestyle that allows him to use both his body and brain.  He will need a private secure garden.

We feel that it would be best for Jax to be rehomed with adults only.

Jax is a typical Mali so likes to be vocal around other dogs, he is easily distracted with toys but we feel like he would be best suited to being the only dog in the home so he can have his own space and the focus on him.

No cats or small furries for Jax due to having a very high prey drive. We would recommend not having any cats within your area.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Rudy
description:
Don’t let his age fool you, this lively, energetic boy has plenty of energy and enthusiasm. Rudy is a friendly, excitable and affectionate boy who absolutely loves attention and fuss.  He has a big personality and is not shy about letting you know when he wants you to interact with him!  Rudy can be quite vocal when he wants your attention or, more importantly, when he thinks it’s time for you to throw his ball.  Rudy’s favourite thing to do is chase his toys, and he could happily spend all afternoon playing and having fun.  He also enjoys his long walks and would love an active home who can provide him with plenty of exercise and opportunities to explore.

Rudy is a strong boy on the lead, so his new adopters will need to be confident handling him and willing to continue working on his lead manners.  He does know his basic commands and with the right guidance, could continue to build on these. He would suit someone who enjoys getting out and about and is looking for a fun, lively companion with a larger-than-life  personality.

We think that Rudy could be rehomed with children who are 13 years and over – subject to a successful meet.

Rudy has interacted well with dogs whilst in our care so we believe that he could potentially be rehomed with another dog of similar size and temperament – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Pearl
description:
Pearl came into our care as a stray so we don’t have much of a history on her. She can be a little vocal around people at first but soon warms up with treats. She is a very sweet gentle girl when she knows you and loves a good fuss. Pearl is an old girl so is looking for a calm, quiet loving home to spend the rest of her years. Pearl loves to curl up under a blanket to keep warm after a nice walk with lots of sniffing. She is still eager to go for a walk and does also enjoy a good run around our enclosed compound area when she has the chance. She loves a boomer ball! Pearl is very food motivated which is a bonus for getting to know her. Pearl would be best suited to a home that has owned a Frenchie before. Due to her older age she does have a few health issues that can be discussed further if you are successful.

We think that Pearl would be best suited to an adult only home.

Pearl has interacted well with dogs whilst in our care, so she can potentially be rehomed with another dog- subject to a successful meet. This dog will need to be of a similar size and a calm  temperament.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Mavis
description:
Mavis came into our care as a stray so we don’t have any history on her. She is a typical Frenchie that likes her own way, especially around new people. She is quite protective of her kennel so will shout at you if you come near her. Out on a walk she is much more confident and can be handled. She is just a cheeky girl! She does like attention and a fuss, on her terms, once she gets to know you. She has the potential to be a very loving companion, she just needs the right home that has the patience to allow her to settle down into a new environment. She may need some basic training once she gets home as we are not sure if she has lived in a home before. Mavis needs an experienced home, either with the breed or with nervous rescue dogs.

Mavis needs to be in an adult only home, no visiting children.

Mavis has socialised well with dogs whilst in our care but we believe she would be best suited to being the only dog in the home.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Dean
description:
Dean is a very friendly boy, he likes to say hello to everyone he meets and loves a fuss. He was a little nervous when he first came in though, it has taken some time for him to reach this point. He loves his toys and can play independently with them in his kennel, he has a favourite toy here which is a string of sausages! He’s a big foody and loves all kinds of tasty snacks. He also enjoys his walks around the woods taking in all of the different smells. With him being a stray there is a possibility that he’s never lived in a home before so some training might be needed to help settle him in. Experience with Frenchie’s is preferred, as they usually have cheeky personalities once they have settled.

Dean needs to be the only dog in the home. He needs continuous socialisation training around dogs to help build his confidence as he can be a little snappy and unsure of new dogs. He has little dog syndrome! His new family must be committed to taking him to training classes.

Dean is best suited to be rehomed with children who are 16 years and over – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Ronnie
description:
Ronnie was very nervous and shut down when he first arrived, very unsure of everyone and didn’t know who he could trust. With time and patients from staff, Ronnie is now a completely different dog. He is a super happy boy, who absolutely loves everyone he meets. As soon as he sees you he’s instantly wiggly and gets all giddy. Ronnie brings a smile to everyone’s face with his amazing personality.

With Ronnie having lots of energy and being super playful, he is looking for an active home. His new home must be an adult only home, due to how nervous he was initial here at the home.

We don’t believe Ronnie would be suitable to live with cats or small animals.

Whilst in our care, Ronnie has socialised really well with other dogs. Therefore, we believe he could potentially live with another dog of a similar temperament and able to deal with his craziness – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Merida
description:
Merida came into our care as stray, therefore we don’t have any previous history on her. When she first arrived at the home, Merida was very nervous and a shy girl. She slowly started to trust staff but can still be nervous and unsure when meeting new people, especially men. Merida is looking for a very patient home, who are understanding and must be committed to do multiple meets here at the home.

Once out of her shell and is confident with you, she’s an absolute sweetheart. Full of life and energy. She thoroughly enjoys being outside on her daily walks. Merida is also super playful, always enjoying time in our enclosed area, playing with toys and staff. Her new family must be active and happy to take her on new adventures.

Whilst being in our care, Merida prefers her own space with other dogs and doesn’t like to be bothered by them. For this reason, she would be best suited to a home with no other dogs. Her new family must be willing to continue with her socialising.

Due to her nervousness, Merida is needing an adult only home, with no visiting children either. She needs a quieter home where she can settle at her pace and feel comfortable. Her new home must be experience and ideally dealt with nervous dogs before.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Rambo
description:
Meet Rambo!  He is a gorgeous boy with a heart full of love.  Rambo is a very sweet affectionate lad who loves spending time outside and enjoying the world around him.  He has so much to offer the right family and is looking for a home where he can truly thrive.  Kennel life is incredibly stressful for Rambo.  He struggles with being confined, often scratching and climbing the bars when he becomes overwhelmed.  However, once he is out of his kennel, he relaxes enjoys his surroundings and is a very happy boy with his tail wagging like mad.  Being returned to his kennel is particularly difficult for him, so he would benefit hugely from a home where he can feel safe, settled and secure.  Rambo loves  – long walks getting out and about, off-lead time in our secure compound where he can chase around with his toys, being brushed and enjoying a little pampering and spending time with people receiving lots of fuss and strokes.  Rambo walks nicely on the lead, making him  a lovely companion for someone who enjoys getting outdoors.  As a Husky, he would need an active lifestyle filled with long walks, hikes, adventures and plenty of opportunities to explore.  Rambo is looking for an active, loving home that understands his needs and can offer him time, exercise and the companionship he deserves.  He will need a private secure garden where he can safely enjoy some off lead time as well as an adopter that is committed to keeping him mentally and physically stimulated.  Most importantly, Rambo needs a home where he can feel relaxed and comfortable, away from the stress of kennel life.

Rambo has socialised well with other dogs while in our care, so we feel he could potentially be rehomed with another dog of similar size following a successful meet and greet.

As Rambo came into the home as a stray we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

If you have a holiday in the next 3 months, please wait until you reply to apply for a dog.

name: Mia
description:
Meet Mia!  Mia is a beautiful girl who is looking for a patient, understanding and experienced home where she can learn that the world isn’t such a scary place.  Mia is a very timid and nervous girl who is still finding her feet with us.  Since arriving 3 months ago, very emaciated and in a bad state she has started to come around with our staff, and has put weight on nicely and we are beginning to see the sweet girl hiding behind all that uncertainty.  Mia is still a bit wary when the staff enter her kennel and will often retreat to the back.  Having her harness put on can also be a worrying experience for her, so she needs gentle handling, reassurance and plenty of time to feel comfortable.  With calm encouragement and a kind approach, Mia responds well and is slowly learning to trust the people around her.  One thing Mia does enjoy is a good brush!  It’s lovely to see her discovering little moments of comfort, and we are celebrating every small step she takes towards building her confidence.  When out in our secure compound, Mia isn’t particularly interested in toys just yet.  She would much rather take her time having a good sniff around and exploring her surroundings at her own pace.  For Mia, it’s all about taking things slowly, without pressure or expectations.  Mia will need an experienced Dogue De Bordeaux owner who understands the breed and is prepared to give her time, patience and the consistency she needs.  She will need someone who can read her body language, respect her boundaries and allow her confidence to grow at her own pace.  She may take time to settle into her new home, but with the right person by her side, we know she will continue to blossom.  Mia isn’t a girl who will rush up to you looking for a fuss just yet.  She’s a girl who needs you to gain her trust, gently and patiently.  But beneath that nervous exterior is a very sweet dog who deserves the chance to feel safe, secure and loved. Mia will need a private secure garden.

Mia has had a heart scan and echo cardiogram done and has a minor mitral valve issue, which currently isn’t causing her any problems.  This will be discussed in detail with the successful applicant.

Mia has interacted with other dogs while in our care, and is very nervous and unsure around them, so we feel she would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home where she can take her time gaining her confidence around other dogs with the full support and gentle guidance of her new adopter.

As Mia came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on her and as she is very timid we would prefer any children/visiting children to be 16+ years.

Please only apply if you have the experience and commitment to work with Mia and give her the time and space she will need.

name: Wolfie
description:
Wolfie is an ex racer who has spent his life in kennels. He is now in need of a loving comfortable home to call his own. As he has never lived in a home before he will need a family that is willing to put in the training needed to get him comfortable in a new environment. He is a friendly boy who doesn’t mind a fuss but can be a little more independent. He is a chilled boy who enjoys spending time snoozing on his bed. He can get excited when he gets to play with toys.

We think that Wolfie could potentially be rehomed with children who are 12 years and over.

Wolfie could potentially be rehomed with another dog of a similar size and calm temperament – subject to a successful meet.

No cats or small furries for Wolfie due to being an ex racer.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Tommy
description:
Tommy is an ex racing greyhound who has spent his life in kennels. He is now looking for a comfortable and loving home to call his own. He will need a family that is happy to introduce and train him around everything that is involved in living in a home environment. Tommy is a very affectionate boy and has been described as a velcro dog by the kennel staff. He is after a home where he can get plenty of attention and cuddles throughout the day. He is a big foodie and is motivated by treats, which is a bonus to help with training.

Tommy is confident around staff and volunteers but due to his size we believe that he would be best suited to an adult only home.

Tommy is a little unsure around most dogs so will need further positive training to help build up his confidence in this area. He is currently paired with another greyhound in the kennel and has has no issues with her, so we believe that he could be rehomed with another calm greyhound or sighthound – subject to a successful meet.

No cats or small furries for Tommy due to his racing background.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Derby
description:
Derby is a sensitive, gentle soul who is still finding his feet and learning that the world doesn’t have to be a scary place. A lot of things at the moment are frightening for him, but we are beginning to see small glimpses of his confidence growing. Although he can be very nervous, underneath his worries is an incredibly affectionate boy who absolutely loves human company. He really enjoys cuddles and gentle strokes, if you dare to stop fussing him, he will reach out with his paw and ask for more. It is impossible not to fall in love with his sweet personality. He spends much of his time curled up on his comfy bed, where he feels safe and secure, but he will pop out to say hello when a familiar face visits his kennel. He enjoys a run around to stretch his legs in compound area, but isn’t sure about toys yet so would much rather stay close his his handler.

He’s had positive, friendly interactions with other dogs so we believe that he could potentially be re homed with a dog of a calm temperament and similar size – subject to a successful meet.

Due to his nervous nature we believe that Derby would be best suited to living in a calm house with children who are 16 years and over – subject to success meet. It is likely that he would need multiple meets to get to know his new family before he goes home.

If you feel that you could provide Derby with a peaceful, patient and understanding forever home please apply for Derby today!

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Amanda
description:
Amanda came into our care as a stray so we don’t have any background information on her. She was a little unsure and nervous when she first arrived but has slowly started to come out of her shell. She can be affectionate once she knows you. She is a typical cheeky Frenchie who likes to have her own way. She is looking for a home with a family that has previous experience or knowledge of the breed and is happy to work with her until she is more settled. We believe that Amanda may need some basic training to help her improve her manners in the home.

Amanda has socialised well with dogs whilst in our care but we feel that she would be best suited to the only dog in the home.

We feel that Amanda would be best suited for an adult only home, no visiting children.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Chopper
description:
Meet Chopper! (27kg) Chopper is a very sweet and friendly boy who has so much love to give. When he first came into our care, he was very barky, but as soon as he got to know the staff and felt safe his personality began to shine through.  He loves a fuss and attention and is always happy to come over for some affection.  He does sometimes forget quite how strong he is when he comes over to say hello – he can be a little enthusiastic with his greetings.  But underneath his big personality is a lovely, affectionate boy who enjoys spending time with people.  Chopper can be quite vocal while in his kennel, but once he is out and about he settles nicely.  He particularly enjoys his off-lead time in our secure compound where he can have a good run.  He also loves getting out for walks in the area exploring, he can be strong on the lead so will need continued lead training.  He would benefit from an active family that can continue giving him plenty of exercise and enrichment.  Chopper will need someone who is willing to commit to his training and socialisation.  Sadly, Chopper came into our care with cropped ears.  His ears will need to be regularly monitored and cared for to ensure they remain healthy, and this will need to be considered by anyone looking to offer him a home.  We are looking for a committed home who will give Chopper the time, structure, exercise and affection he deserves.  In return, you’ll have a loving, fun and affectionate boy who is ready to enjoy the next chapter of his life.  He will need a private secure garden.

Chopper has interacted ok with other dogs whilst in our care, but we do feel he would be best rehomed as the only dog in the household where he can get 100% of the attention and training.

As Chopper came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Albie
description:
Meet Albie!  Albie is a lovely boy with a big personality and lots of love to give.  He is a very friendly, affectionate and excitable boy who loves being around people and getting plenty of attention.  He can be a real giddy lad and, when he’s excited, he does jump up for attention and can be a bit mouthy.  He is also very vocal in his kennel.  With his high energy levels, Albie will need an active home where he can enjoy plenty of exercise, long walks and adventures.  He absolutely loves getting out and about, exploring his surroundings and taking in all the interesting smells.  He is quite strong on the lead so will need continued lead training.  He also enjoys playing with his toys, although he prefers to play on his own with them and will chase around our compound proudly showing you what he has got. Albie does know some basic commands, but will benefit from further training and guidance to help him develop into the best version of himself.  His new adopter will need to continue working on his manners, particularly around jumping up and mouthing when over-excited.  Ongoing socialisation will also be important for him.  As well as physical exercise, Albie will need plenty of mental stimulation to keep his clever and energetic mind occupied.  Enrichment, training games, interactive toys and learning new skills would all be great ways to help him burn off some of that enthusiasm.  Albie is looking for an active and committed home that will enjoy his fun-loving personality, give him plenty of exercise and enrichment, and be willing to continue his training and socialisation.  In return, he has plenty of affection, enthusiasm and fun to offer.  Albie will need a private secure garden.

Albie has interacted with other dogs while in our care and we have found him to be very under-socialised.  He can be very unsure around some and will bark and others he will have a sniff but still a little uncomfortable. We feel he would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home where his new adopter can continue building up his confidence around other dogs with plenty of positive reinforcement in a controlled environment and they must go at Albie’s pace.

As Albie came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Milo
description:
Meet Milo!  Milo is an absolute sweetheart and a real people-lover.  This lovely boy is happiest when he has your undivided attention and, if he had his way, he’d spend his days right by your side soaking up cuddles and affection.  He really is a needy cuddle bug.  Milo enjoys having some off-lead time in our secure compound, where he loves to stretch his legs and have a good run around.  But it doesn’t take him long before he comes trotting back to your side, ready for some more fuss.  He can be a little mouthy when he gets over-excited, especially when he desperately wants your attention, so he’ll need someone who can help him learn to manage that excitement and give him some positive guidance.  He is just a gorgeous boy with a huge love for people.  If you are looking for a loyal companion who will happily follow you around, and shower you with affection and make sure you never feel lonely, Milo could be the boy for you.  As Milo is a real people dog and thrives on having company, he would be best suited to a home where someone is around most of the day.

Milo has interacted with other dogs whilst in our care, and he doesn’t seem too interested in them so we feel he would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home where he can get 100% of the fuss and cuddles.

As Milo came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on him, so we would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Rafi
description:
Rafi is a lively, happy boy with a cheeky personality. Rafi is still just a young boy who is in need of a stable and loving home. He is after a family that is happy to put in a lot of time and effort into his training to help him improve his manners. Dobermans are a breed that need to be worked with for their entire life so we are after someone who is fully committed to taking on this responsibility. Experience with this breed or similar is also a must.

Rafi is going to need a large fully enclosed garden that he can have off lead time in, to burn off energy and to help with his training. Rafi will need plenty of walks and mental stimulation to keep him occupied so he doesn’t cause too much mischief. Rafi would benefit from a home where someone is around a lot and has plenty of free time to focus on him and his training.

Rafi is best suited to an adult only home, with no visiting children.

Rafi needs to be the only dog in the home, no visiting dogs either. Rafi is currently under going socialisation training with dogs to help improve his reactivity. This is something that will need to be continued when he goes home and into the future.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Todd
description:
This handsome boy is Todd!  Todd is a sweet, friendly and very lively boy with plenty of energy to spare!  He is a typical hound in many ways – full of enthusiasm, curious about the world around him and always ready for his next adventure.  He absolutely loves his off-lead time in our secure compound where he can stretch his legs, explore, have a sniff and have fun with his favourite toys.  Watching Todd enjoy himself is a real pleasure! As you would expect from a Fox Hound, Todd is high-energy and needs a very active home that can provide him with plenty of daily exercise.  Walks alone may not be enough to keep his body and mind satisfied, so he would really benefit from additional activities such as scent work, tracking games, enrichment and other opportunities to use his wonderful Hound brain.  Todd is also a vocal boy – hounds are known for their voices, and Todd is certainly not shy about using his!  His new family will need to appreciate that hound singing, baying and general commentary are part of the package.  Hounds are also known for being escape artists so he will need secure, hound-proof fencing and careful management, particularly when he is outdoors. A home that understands the determination and curiosity of a scent-driven hound would be ideal.  Todd has so much character and has all the makings of a fantastic companion in the right home.  He needs someone who understands that a Fox Hound is a lifestyle, not just a pet – but for the right home, Todd will bring plenty of fun, affection and adventure.

Todd has socialised well with other dogs whilst in our care and is very playful and full-on.  We do feel he could potentially live with another dog of similar energy levels that would tolerate his play style following a successful meet and greet.

As Todd came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Shadow
description:
Shadow is a very affectionate boy who has been super friendly to our staff and volunteers since he came in to our care. With him being an ex racer, he does have a high prey drive so can try to chase squirrels whilst out for his walks! He absolutely loves chasing his toys around our secure compound.  He is a really affectionate boy who loves lots of fuss and attention.

Shadow will have spent most of his life in kennels with his racing background, so he may feel a little nervous going in to a home environment. We also do not know if he is house trained or toilet trained due to this. He loves to lie in his comfy beds after his walks – we sometimes catch him upside down showing his belly off!

Shadow has now been in our care for 237 days and is desperately searching for his forever home.

We think Shadow would prefer to be the only dog in the home as he can sometimes be a little unsure around them and isn’t too interested in interacting with them.

He could also potentially live with children 14+ years  – subject to a successful meet.

Shadow would love a home where he could relax and enjoy his retirement years and rest on a comfy bed (or couch) of his own!

name: Prince
description:
Prince came into our care as a stray so we don’t have much history on him. We do believe that he could have potentially lived in a home previously and that he isn’t from a racing background. Prince is a happy excitable boy that jumps up in the kennel when you go into him. He can get very giddy for his walks and loves to be outside taking in all of the different smells. Prince has enjoyed different kinds of enrichment in between his walks and loves playing with his toys. He is a sweet boy who is after a loving forever home.

Prince has been rehomed recently but showed signs of  having separation anxiety so he is in need of a home where someone is around most of the time and is able to build up his time being left. Experience with sight hounds or rescue dogs will be beneficial to ensure that he is getting the training that he needs to settle into a new home.

Prince would be best suited to a home with children who are 16 years and over due to his bouncy nature – subject to a successful meet.

Prince initially could be vocal around dogs due to being a little unsure, we have now found out this is due to him wanting to say hello. He has been on group walks recently and loved interacting with other dogs and saying hello. He can be very enthusiastic when meeting dogs so we need someone that is able to physically hold onto him so he can continue on with his socialisation  training and learn better manners around dogs. We still think it would be best for him to be the only dog in the home so he can be the main focus.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Swan
description:
Swan came into our care as a stray, meaning we don’t have any previous history on her. She is a very friendly and affection girl, who loves nothing more than a good cuddle with you. As Swan is still young, she would be best suited to an active home able to give her the regular exercise that she requires. Swan thoroughly enjoys playing in our enclosed area where she loves playing and chasing tennis balls.

At times Swan can be a little boisterous and fully on when she gets all excited to see you. We believe she would be best suited to a home with children no younger than 16 years old – subject to a successful meet.

During her time with us, Swan has shown to a social towards other dogs, although at times can be a little over the top and vocal, which is typical of her breed. We do think she would prefer to be only dog in the home, where she can happily play with her own toys and not share her space.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Hero
description:
Hero is an ex racing greyhound who is now looking for his forever home with a family that can help him settle into life beyond the kennels. He is a confident, lively boy with plenty of personality. He gets very excited when it’s time for a walk and can jump around on the lead, so will need someone who is comfortable handling a tall strong greyhound. With a little training and consistency this is something that can be worked on. Although he is confident in many ways, he does need help building his confidence when it comes to being touched and handled as he can get a little worried.  Hero deserves the chance to learn, grow and discover just how good life can be outside of kennels.

Hero can be rehomed with mature children who are 16 years and over, due to his size and bouncy nature. This will be subject to a successful meet.

Hero is currently paired with another greyhound and has interreacted well with dogs whilst in our care, so we believe that he would be rehomed with another dog- subject to a successful meet and greet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3  months.

name: Bear
description:
Bear is a very nervous boy when he meets new people for the first time. It takes a little while for him to come around but with patience and yummy treats he slowly starts to trust you. Once he has gained your trust and is comfortable he is an affectionate boy and loves to give out kisses. He will need to have multiple regular meets before going home.

Bear is a big dog who doesn’t understand his size, he is constantly jumping up for cuddles and doesn’t know what personal space is. Bear is going to require a lot of training to help him learn manners. He can be a very cheeky boy at times! He will need socialising in different environments and around people to help him build his confidence up. Bear gets super excited when going for walks and is very strong on the lead, this is another area that will need more training. Bear loves playing with his toys, splashing around in water and zooming around our enclosed area.

Bear is after an adult only home that has previous experience with big boisterous dogs. No regular visiting children either please. He is going to need a very active home with a family that is able to provide him with plenty of exercise and mental stimulation to keep him busy. As he is still only a young dog he can get up to mischief when he is bored. Bear’s new family need to be committed to putting in the training that he needs not only initially but keeping it up for the rest of his life.

Bear needs to be the only dog in the home so that he can have all of attention to help get him settled. Bear can interact well with dogs whilst out on walks but will need further training to help improve this.

We know that Bear is going to require a lot of work at first but once he is trained he will make a lovely family dog who will love going on plenty of adventures. Taking on a dog this size is a big commitment, please ensure that you are serious and have thought about the future before applying.

name: Ripley
description:
Meet Ripley!! He is a gorgeous boy looking for an active, committed home where he can continue to learn and thrive.  He’s a friendly, affectionate boy with a fun-loving personality and is always ready for a game with his favourite toys.  He is full of energy and loves to play, so he will need an active family who can provide plenty of exercise, enrichment, and ongoing training.  Like many young dogs, he can become a little mouthy and nippy when he’s excited, so he will benefit from patient guidance and positive reinforcement to help him learn appropriate manners.  He is still working on his basic commands and will need someone willing to continue his training.  He can also occasionally rag his lead, so further lead training will be important.  Previous experience with Shar-pei’s would be a real advantage, as they can have their own unique characteristics and training needs.  He currently has a cherry eye, which will be surgically repaired before he goes to his new home, so he’ll be ready to start his next chapter feeling his best.  If you’re looking for a playful, lively young dog and have to time and commitment to help him become the wonderful companion we know he can be, Ripley could be the boy for you.

Ripley has socialised well with other dogs and is very playful with them.  He can sometimes get frustrated and bark if he can’t get to them straight away.  We feel he could potentially be rehomed with another playful dog of similar size following a successful meet and greet.

As Ripley came into the home as a stray we have no previous history on him and as he can be a little nippy when over-excited we would like any children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Star
description:
Star is a typical Patterdale Terrier who is always raring to go! She loves being outdoors, exploring new smells and trying to chase any wildlife she comes across. Star would love a fully enclosed garden where she can enjoy plenty of secure off-lead time and burn off some of her energy. Patterdale experience is essential as she can have her cheeky moments and will need a family who understands her spirited nature. Star has been rehomed twice previously so is looking for a patient family that has a lot of experience with dogs that need extra training and time to settle into a new life in a home.

We have found that Star struggles when left alone, so her new family will need to be around for most of the time. She will need someone who has the time, patience and commitment to help her settle into her new life and feel comfortable in a home environment. As Star was found as a stray, we don’t have much background information about her. However, we know she is an energetic, characterful girl who will thrive with the right family, plenty of exercise and lots of love.

Star may require multiple meets so she can get to know her new family before going home. Her new family will need to be patient and understanding whilst she is settling in and getting used to her new surroundings.

We think that it is best for Star to be rehomed to an adult only home with no visiting children.

Star can be very vocal around dogs and get overwhelmed easily so will need to be the only dog in the home. She will need continuous training to help her improve her confidence.

We wouldn’t recommend Star to be rehomed with cats due to her breed.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3  months.

name: Nibbles
description:
Nibbles is a young boy who is full of energy and has a lot of love to give. Nibbles loves being off lead in our enclosed area running around chasing tennis balls. He has a lot of energy so will need a very active home with a family who can take him out on lots of adventures to burn off his energy. He would benefit from mental stimulation in between walks to keep his brain stimulated. Due to being a young dog Nibbles will need further training to help him grow up to be a well mannered boy, he can be a little nippy at times too.

Nibbles came into our care as a stray so we don’t have any history on him. Due to being very friendly we think that he can be rehomed with dog savvy children who are 16 years and older – subject to a successful meet.

Nibbles is friendly with every dog he meets and always wants to play. He can potentially be rehomed with another dog that can tolerate his high energy and playfulness – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Elias
description:
Elias is a very sweet and friendly boy. He came into our care as a stray so we don’t have any background information on him. He has always been friendly with staff and volunteers whilst here. Elias can be a little strong on the lead due to his size so some basic lead training would be beneficial for him. We are looking for an active home for Elias as he has a lot of energy and would enjoy going on lots of adventures. Elias is a calm boy in his kennel and loves to have some down time with a tasty chew.

Elias is a friendly boy but due to his size we believe that it would be best for him to be rehomed with children over 14 years and over – Subject to a successful meet.

Elias needs a little more training around dogs since his castration as he has become a little unsure, therefore we believe that Elias would benefit from being the only dog in the home as he would prefer all the attention on him.

name: Ronnie
description:
Ronnie is a cheeky girl who is looking for a caring forever home. She is a bouncy girl that is full of energy and would love to go out for lots of adventures. She constantly wants to be out on walks and tries her hardest to escape from the kennel when the door is open- she’s a cheeky monkey! She is super friendly with everyone she meets and enjoys shouting at you if you try to ignore her- she constantly wants attention. Ronnie has shown signs of separation anxiety so is looking for an experienced home that has dealt with this previously. Ronnie is a typical Frenchie so she is in need of a home that has owned Frenchie’s previously.

She is a friendly girl but can get a little jealous when the attention isn’t on her, so we believe it would be best for her to be in an adult only home with no visiting children. Ronnie would be best suited to a quiet home with not many visitors.

Ronnie has socialised well with other dogs whilst in our care, however, we believe she would be best suited to a home where she can be the only dog, so she can have all the attention and love. She may need on going socialisation training around dogs due to her being in the kennels for so long.

name: Sam
description:
Sam is a very loveable boy who just wants to give out hugs to everyone he meets, he does sometimes forget how big he is though. He’s a big hit with volunteers here and they all love taking him out for his walks as they get to have lots of cuddles. He can be strong on the lead though due to his size. He’s a very sweet boy who has a big heart and is looking for someone to show him lots of love! Sam has enjoyed his walks around the woods, watching the ducks and wildlife around him. Sam would appreciate an enclosed garden that he can spend his time in relaxing and enjoying the sun. Sam loves his treats, nothing is too big or small for him – he isn’t fussy!

Sam is super friendly with everyone he meets but due to his giddy jumpy nature we believe that it would be best to rehome Sam with children over the age of 16 – subject to a successful meet and greet.

Sam needs to be the only dog in the home, he can be vocal around dogs so needs a family that has experience to help build his confidence and manners.

If you think that you could provide a comfortable home with lots of treats for Sam please apply now!

name: Cali
description:
Cali was a very nervous girl when she first arrived at the home, which was over 200 days now! It has taken a lot of time for staff and volunteers to get to know Cali and bring out her excitable, bubbly personality. Cali loves going for walks and off lead runs in our compound area, she will always be found with a football in her mouth. She loves to dodge past you whilst you try and catch her, her tail never stops wagging. Cali loves her treats and sits nicely whilst you give them to her. She has been toilet trained whilst in our care, which is a bonus for when she goes home.

Cali can be strong on the lead at times due to her excitement to get outside and enjoy the fresh air but can walk nicely after her initial excitement is over, especially on a harness. Cali would love a fully enclosed garden with someone around most of the time so that she can come and go as she pleases. Cali spends most of her day relaxing on a comfy bed watching people come and go. She can be a little barky in her kennel at first but this is due to her wanting to say hello to everyone.

Cali isn’t a cuddly kind of girl but would love a family that is willing to keep her entertained and will play with her toys. We believe that Cali needs to be in an adult only home, with a family that has experience with rescue dogs or bull breeds.

Cali was nervous of dogs when she first came into our care so we think that it is best that she is the only dog in the house. With a lot of socialisation she now is a friendly girl that is happy to say hello to most dogs that she meets.

We think that it would be best for Cali to not be in a house with cats.

If you think you can give this gorgeous girl her forever home please apply!

name: Pearl
description:
This talkative girl is Pearl.  She is a very affectionate, confident and friendly girl that is always up for lots of fuss and strokes.  She can be very vocal when she wants your attention so probably not suitable for an apartment/flat.  She enjoys her walks everyday having a sniff about and saying hello to everyone she meets.  She is very strong on the lead so will need an experienced owner that is used to powerful dogs. Pearl would benefit from a private secure garden.

Pearl has socialised with other dogs whilst in our care, she can be a little unsure at first but does come around after a bit, so we feel she may be best suited as the only dog in the home where she can take her time getting used to other dogs with lots of positive reinforcement from her new adopter.

As Pearl came into the home as a stray we have no previous history on her so would prefer any children in the home to be 12+ years.

name: Bella
description:
Bella is looking for a home through no fault of her own and is fully house trained, but would benefit from having any solo time built up gradually. She can live with teenagers as she has a tendency to get mouthy when she's overstimulated, and potentially a calm and well matched dog following a successful meeting at the centre, but no cats.

Bella is a sweet and bright young girl who loves to play with her toys and learn new tricks.  Although she can be a little worried by new people at first she quickly comes round once she realises there might be a tasty snack or two on offer.  Bella enjoys her walks and is manageable on lead but she will need her new family to help build her confidence as she can be wary in unfamiliar situations.  Once she knows you she loves a fuss and but she will let you know when she has had enough and she should be given the freedom to take herself away in these moments.  She is a playful pup who loves to chase her toys around and is so much fun to spend time with.  She loves her food and quickly picks up new tricks so would love a family who can offer her plenty of time to do this to keep her busy and build her confidence.

name: Jack
description:
Jack is looking for a family who’ll be around for most of the day while he settles into his new surroundings, gradually building up his time alone. He’ll need some support with building confidence and socialising around other dogs. Jack Will be best suited to being the only dog in the home and can live with children of secondary-school age. A home with a garden would be ideal for his much loved zoomies! Jack has previously been housetrained, so he should just need a little refresher as he settles into his new routine.

Meet Jack, a handsome chap who’s ready to enjoy all the luxuries of home life. Enthusiastic with his play, he’s all legs and paws! Jack loves his toys and is happy for you to get involved too. He’d love to join on family days out and continue the quality time with sofa snuggles. Jack will be a great dog to welcome into your life and home.

name: Belle
description:
Belle, AKA the Speedy Queen, is a sweet four-year-old Spaniel looking for a home where she can show off her playful personality and enjoy all the adventures her heart desires! She can live with children of preschool age and above, can be left home alone for a few hours and is happy to travel in the car. Belle would prefer to be the only pet in the home, but she can still enjoy meeting and making friends with other dogs along the way.

Belle’s toys are the absolute light of her life! This energetic girl has plenty of energy to burn and would love a family who can keep up with her adventurous spirit. She has a wonderfully goofy side that’s guaranteed to make you smile, whether she’s climbing into her toy box or whizzing around doing her excited zoomies. And, if that wasn’t adorable enough, she even does the cutest little spin when asked! Belle is a super-friendly, sociable girl who loves putting her nose to work just as much as she enjoys a good old cuddle on your lap.

name: Ethel
description:
Meet Ethel our sweet 2 year old JRT cross. This sweet girl would love to be the only dog in the home, but does enjoy mixing with other dogs with a similar play style. She can be worried by new people and is looking for a home that can show her that the world isn't a scary place. She is initially looking for someone who is around most of the time and can build up her leaving hours slowly.

Ethel is a funny, playful character who loves to do zoomies. She has had some really positive interaction with dogs here at the centre and has the possibility to live with another dog post adoption. She does need to be muzzled at the vets (but in her defence no one likes going to the doctors). This sweet little girl will be a great addition to the right home.

name: Douglas
description: Meet Douglas, our beautiful 10-year-old Border Collie! Although he is visually impaired, this sweet boy still enjoys life to the fullest and loves to explore the world using his nose and ears instead. Douglas is friendly to people, however, he can get a bit of a fright sometimes due to his visual impairment. He will need a patient family who are able to take things at his pace. He is also really friendly and polite with other dogs, and always has a very waggy tail when he can tell a dog is nearby. He has stolen the heart of his foster carer who describes him as "the sweetest dog", and she loves that he greets her every morning with lots of kisses! Douglas really enjoys his walks and will happily take his time sniffing and exploring to his heart's content. His visual impairment means that he needs some time to get used to a new environment, but he is a confident boy who adapts quickly! Douglas is looking for a calm, patient home where he can settle at his own pace & enjoy the quieter things in life, and he could live with older secondary aged children and above. This gentle, affectionate soul has so much love to give - could you help Douglas enjoy his well-earned retirement? AWE licence number 13090 by West Lothian Council.

name: Chanel
description:
Meet Chanel, a 10-year-old Yorkshire Terrier. Chanel is looking for a quiet home where she can spend her time curled up next to someone and be their little shadow. Chanel could live with another calm dog, pending meets at the centre. She has been around a cat briefly and could live with one. Chanel is suitable to live with primary-aged children.

Chanel is a sweet older girl who loves curling up next to someone for a snooze. She has not shown much interest in toys but loves her food. She does not have any teeth, so her tongue will permanently hang out of her mouth. Chanel likes to follow people around and keep them company. Could this sweet senior girl be your pawfect match?

name: Betty
description:
Betty is looking for an active home with a private, secure garden where she can enjoy spending time with her family and show off her zoomies. She could live with children of secondary school age and above and would prefer to be the only pet in the home so she can enjoy all the attention to herself. Betty's ideal home will have access to quiet walks and will be happy to keep her on lead and muzzled out on adventures as she can be reactive to other dogs.

Meet Betty our 7 year old German Shepherd cross Staffordshire Bull Terrier who is looking for her forever home who can embrace her larger than life character. Betty loves playing with her favourite toys and is a very foody girl which is perfect for her continued training. This oversized lap dog can often be found sat at her handlers feet looking for fuss, she does also jump straight in the car which is ideal for heading out on quieter adventures. Betty has so much to offer and would make a fantastic addition to a family who can support her and give her time as she settles into her new home.

name: Johnny
description:
Johnny is a nervous boy looking for a patient family where any children are older teenagers. He can live with another dog but has a full-on play style that another dog would need to match or tolerate, and he could potentially live with a dog-savvy cat also. He will require quite a few meetings at the centre before going home as it takes him time to build trust in strangers. Johnny is house trained and has been good when left by himself for an hour or two. We would be happy to let Johnny have a trial period at home before committing to adoption, and our team are more than happy to discuss this with anyone who may be interested in making Johnny part of their family.

Young Johnny has been in our care for most of his life and is looking for a special family to change his fortune. He is a nervous boy but does well with a slow approach and we've seen his confidence increase enormously since his arrival. Johnny has gone from hiding on the inside part of his kennel to happily greeting his handlers at his door, but he will still take himself away from strangers at times. Johnny adores other dogs and in a previous home he was quickly playing off lead with the local hounds and absolutely in his element. He’s a big fan of horses too and doesn’t seem to have any interest in chasing cats, preferring to stop and say hello any he comes across. Johnny happier saying hello to folks when they bring him nibbles, and the more time he spends with people the more comfortable he visibly becomes, so the slow approach is definitely the way forward for him. Johnny is so playful and to see him run around with other dogs is an absolute joy. He has so much potential, he just needs the right family to guide him.

name: Todd
description:
Ready to be welcomed into family life is Todd! Todd is looking for a family who’ll be around for most of the day while he settles into home life. He’ll need any alone time building up and house training started. Due to his size, he’d be best suited to a home with older primary school aged children. Todd has shown us that he’s sociable with other dogs, so he may be able to live with another doggy friend.

Todd is an amazing lad with a big heart to match his size! This gentle giant loves making new friends and greets them with a happy, waggy tail. He’s a dream to walk on the lead and takes his treats politely, showing off his lovely manners. After a day of making friends and taking in the sights on outings, Todd would love nothing more than a comfy sofa where he can stretch out and enjoy a well-earned snooze. A big, lovable softie who’s sure going to be a delightful addition to the family!

name: Splinter
description:
Splinter is a 2yr old Yorkie who is currently out living in a foster home. He is a friendly lad so is able to live with primary school aged children. Although we have no history of Splinter with cats, he does have potential to share his home with them following a scent swap and gradual introductions in the home. Splinter has had an operation to help him with his hips, and will benefit from ongoing hydrotherapy or physiotherapy.

Splinter found his way into our care after being found as a stray. He'll appreciate being introduced to the basics, things like housetraining and being left alone. Splinter has been happy to jump into a car for travel.

name: Arthur
description:
Arthur is looking for a home as the only pet. He would love a patient family that would support him with further positive socialisation in the home as he can be conflicted around dogs. Arthur is a very friendly boy and loves a cuddle!

Arthur is a beautiful bouncy boy that has lots of love to give! His favourite thing in life is toys so a full toy box is a must. He can live with sensible secondary school aged children that have experience around bouncy dogs.

name: Sky
description:
Sky can live with robust primary aged kids and a confident cat, but we have been unable to mix her off lead at present, so she'll need to be the only dog at home for now. Sky has been used to living outside and you'll need to be patient whilst she gets to grips with house training.

Sky is such a friendly girl and just lives for fusses and cuddles. She's recently had puppies and is now ready to find herself a family that want to pamper and spoil her. Sky has been used to living outside for the most part and might take a little time to get fully used to living indoors, so we'd advise that any alone time she spends is built up gradually. She loves to meet people and happily introduces herself to other dogs too, having an introductory sniff and then going about her day. Sky has been used to being around children and is a great family dog, she's going to make somebody very happy indeed.

name: Wellie
description:
Meet Wellie the 4 month old crossbreed. Wellie is a playful pup looking for a home that can help him grow into a well mannered young man! Wellie could live with pre-school aged children and another dog pending a successful mix here at the centre. Wellie is a smart boy but will need to learn all the basics tricks. Any time left alone will need be built up slowly so he can understand that its not so scary!

Wellie loves to play with his favourite toys and work for tasty treats! After a long day of puppy fun he loves a nice long nap and someone's arms to cuddle up in. He enjoys exploring and learning new smells in the garden followed by lots of puppy zoomies! If you are looking for an adorable youngster who will be sure to keep you busy, then Wellie may be the perfect match for you!

name: Nova
description:
Nova and Luna have a lovely bond are looking for a forever home together. They are looking to join a family who are around majority of day and able to provide plenty of TLC. This beautiful pair enjoy a good run about and would love a garden for zoomies and playtime as well as basking in the sunshine. Nova and Luna can live with secondary school aged kids but not with any other pets.

Looking for double the love? Then this adorable pair will certainly provide! They both are a lovely mixture of playful and affectionate, giddy and calm. Nova and Luna like to play together and share their toys and going on days out to explore. Both travel well in the car too. They adore company from each other and their humans and can’t wait to be welcomed into a loving family and have a sofa to snuggle up on together.

name: Tina
description:
Tina is a 5 month old female Cross-Breed.

Tina was abandoned outside a rescuer’s shelter in Romania together with her 6 siblings. They are now nearly 5 months old.

Tina can travel to the UK if she has an offer of a home. A delightful, friendly girl, she will be large size when fully grown.

She loves to play. Not cat tested. Loves other dogs. Vaccinated. She will also be tested for Brucellosis. The test is sent to the UK prior to travel.

Tina will need some lead training. Tina would suit a home with someone who is there most of the day and who can offer her a full and active life.

No small children because of her size. She would benefit from a good-sized garden. Someone who will walk with her. Tina is not spayed because of her young age.

Looking for someone with experience and patience. Adoption fee £550, a home check is requested and there is rescue back up.

name: Dora
description:
Dora is a medium English Setter, 11 years old.

Dora is a beautiful older girl who has found herself looking for a new home after being surrendered simply because she is now considered too old to hunt.

But don’t let her age fool you – Dora still has plenty of love, energy, and joy to share.

She is sociable and gets along wonderfully with other dogs. Dora currently shares her kennel with Boss, a fellow ‘senior’ setter, and the two have formed a lovely companionship. They enjoy spending time together and love playing together in the enclosed field.

With people, Dora can be a little shy at first as she takes a moment to feel safe with new faces.

However, once she gets to know you, she quickly blossoms into a cheerful, affectionate, and loving companion.

Dora is still quite active but would love to find a home where she can enjoy gentle exercise, companionship, and a comfortable sofa.

Currently in Spain, transport available to the UK.

name: Boss
description:
Boss is a medium English Setter, 10 years old

Boss is a charming older gentleman who is looking for a loving home after being given up due to his age.

For his age, Boss is still active and enjoys stretching his legs and running in the enclosure, especially alongside his friend Dora. The two share a lovely bond and make a delightful pair.

Boss loves his food and has a great appetite. He has a calm, balanced nature and is incredibly affectionate with people, always seeking out attention.

He absolutely adores cuddles making him a perfect companion for anyone looking for a loving, loyal friend.

Boss would thrive in a home where he can enjoy both relaxed companionship snuggled on a sofa, and some gentle walks.

Currently in Spain, transport available to the UK.

name: Seiko
description:
How has a 6 year old pure bred akita ended up in shelter for the past 6 months 🙁 He’s a lovely, friendly boy who does not deserve this so late in life.

Given his nature we can only assume he was well-loved before, but not quite loved enough to be cared for his whole life. This is particularly heartbreaking given how fiercely loyal akitas are.

His name is Seiko and he is ready to be adopted, fostered, or we will consider foster with a view to adopt.

He is your typical akita – affectionate and wants attention for himself. For that reason he is best homed as an only dog.

Seiko is a well-rounded boy from the small experiences he’s had since arriving – calm at the vets, travels well, walks well on the leash, takes treats gently.

All Seiko asks for is a comfy bed, nice walks, and someones love and attention. It’s best for any home to be experienced with a larger breed or even with the akita breed.

Please let’s not let Seiko waste any more of his short life caged up. He deserves to know love again after being heartlessly abandoned.

name: Gabriel
description:
Gabriel is a 2 year old male Cross-Breed who is affectionate, friendly, and ready to start his new life with a loving family.

Gabriel arrived at the shelter with his sister Gabriella a year ago. They were found together as strays. From the minute they arrived, they were super friendly and loving towards the shelter staff.

For a while, they shared a kennel just the two of them and were very attached. To give them a better chance at adoption, they are now mixing with other dogs and can be adopted separately or together. They will be OK either way.

We think they are approximately 2 years old. They both get on well with other dogs, usually quite aloof and in their own little world. They are well behaved and adore people and lots of cuddles.

Both of them require a home that will take them on exciting walks and preferably have a large garden for them to run around in.

Both Gabriel and Gabriella have been superstars in the shelter. We just hope their situation changes soon. Living their young lives in a small kennel is not what they are here for.

They are here to be adored, and you will get plenty of love and cuddles in return.

Gabriel and Gabriella can be adopted in Cyprus or in the UK. They are both ready to fly. They will be neutered, vaccinated, and have a full health check and blood tests for infectious diseases.

name: Pebble
description:
Pebble is a 1 year old, medium-sized, female Cross-Breed who is a friendly, happy girl eagerly waiting for her forever home. She does not know what being a puppy truly means.

She should be enjoying life in a loving home, cared for and cherished, warm at night instead of sleeping on a concrete floor.

Confiscated from her owners, Pebble and her three siblings have all been in the shelter since they were just young pups. Arguably, it was the best thing to happen to them, but now they each really need a home and family to call their own.

Pebble is a medium-sized dog who will need ongoing training to help her settle into home life. She has gotten used to walking on a lead and is well behaved on walks.

She is also wonderful with other dogs and children. Even though she is young, Pebble and all of her siblings give off a lovely calming energy and we suspect they will be medium energy once in a home.

Pebble is far too young to spend her days in a shelter and has missed an important stage of learning and exploring, but it’s never too late for dogs! She could live with a single person, a couple, or a family. A secure garden and nice walks would be ideal.

Pebble can be adopted in Cyprus or the UK. She has been tested for infectious diseases, is spayed, will travel with a passport, be vaccinated, including rabies, and receive regular flea and worm treatments.

Full rescue back-up is provided by Saving Souls Animal Rescue, a UK-based registered charity.

Foster placement, foster view to adopt, and adoption all considered.

name: Gabriella
description:
Gabriella is a 2 year old female Cross-Breed who is friendly, affectionate, and ready to find her forever home.

Gabriella arrived at the shelter with her brother Gabriel a year ago. They were found together as strays. From the minute they arrived, they were super friendly and loving towards the shelter staff.

For a while, they shared a kennel just the two of them and were very attached. To give them a better chance at adoption, they are now mixing with other dogs and can be adopted separately or together. They will be OK either way.

We think they are approximately 2 years old. They both get on well with other dogs, usually quite aloof and in their own little world. They are well behaved and adore people and lots of cuddles.

Both of them require a home that will take them on exciting walks and preferably have a large garden for them to run around in.

Both Gabriel and Gabriella have been superstars in the shelter. We just hope their situation changes soon. Living their young lives in a small kennel is not what they are here for.

They are here to be adored, and you will get plenty of love and cuddles in return.

Gabriel and Gabriella can be adopted in Cyprus or in the UK. They are both ready to fly. They will be neutered, vaccinated, and have a full health check and blood tests for infectious diseases.

name: Rex
description:
Rex is a 2 year old male Cross-Breed who was surrendered by his owner after previously living in a home.

We know he lived in a home before, which makes it even more heartbreaking that he has known comfort and a human companion and has now found himself in a cage day in and day out.

It is not unusual for dogs like Rex to find themselves waiting in kennels for months or even years due to their intimidating size. But Rex is the calmest and biggest softy.

Rex is remarkably sweet and affectionate with people. He adores fuss and craves a good cuddle. Having said that, he does not like other dogs, so he needs to be homed as the only dog.

We do not want Rex to lose the best years of his life in a cage. His size should not matter. He is a dog and deserves a home just like the small, cute, fluffy dogs that get adopted so easily. Rex will be a wonderful companion.

Rex can be adopted in Cyprus or the UK. He has been tested for infectious diseases, will travel with a passport, be vaccinated, including rabies, and receive regular flea and worm treatments.

His adoption fees are sponsored, so we are only asking for travel costs.

name: Margot
description:
Margot is an 18-month-old female Collie Cross. She is a medium-sized dog based in York and is looking for a patient and understanding home.

Margot came into rescue in Romania with her mother and siblings when she was just a tiny puppy after spending time in a shelter.

She has been in her foster home for one month and is gradually settling into her new surroundings. Margot is a shy and gentle girl who is still building her confidence.

She would benefit greatly from living with other dogs, as their presence helps her feel more secure and encourages her confidence to grow.

Margot enjoys the company of other dogs and is suitable to live in a home with canine companions. She can also live with dog-savvy cats that understand how to interact respectfully with dogs.

Her calm and gentle nature means she has the potential to fit well into the right household environment.

She can live with older children who will be patient and considerate of her shy personality. A quieter home that allows her to settle at her own pace would help her continue making progress. Her future family should be prepared to give her time to adjust and develop trust.

Margot is mostly clean in the home, although she may occasionally have the odd accident as she continues to settle and learn. She is currently undergoing lead training and is making progress with this important skill.

She can also be left alone when accompanied by another dog, which provides her with reassurance and companionship.

With continued support, understanding, and the company of other dogs, Margot has every opportunity to flourish.

She is a sweet-natured young dog who is looking for a loving home where she can continue to gain confidence and enjoy life as part of a family.

name: Indie
description:
Indie is an 18 month old female small Cross-Breed.

This gorgeous girl is an absolute joy – calm, gentle and full of love. She is affectionate and has a very sweet nature. She can be a little shy in new situations and meeting new people but a good natured resident dog will make all the difference.

She travels well in the car especially when she realises there is a good walk in the offing. She loves to smell all the different things around her from wildflowers to rabbit poo!

She really loves going to the beach where she can roll in the sand and have a really good run around.

Indie walks beautifully on the lead and her recall has come on well. Indie loves playing with other dogs and having a friendly dog to snuggle up with.

She is an absolutely super little girl and all she wants now is a loving home of her own with a resident dog to be her best friend.

Originally from Romania, indie was rescued with her siblings from a hoarding situation there.

Please get in touch if you can give Indie the forever home she needs and deserves.

name: Robbie
description:
Robbie is a small cross-breed puppy of approximately 8 months old as of June 26.

Robbie is currently living in a cage-free foster home in Bulgaria and is expected to remain a small dog when fully grown.

Like many of our rescue puppies, Robbie had an uncertain start in life, but he has blossomed into a happy, affectionate and well-socialised young boy who is now ready to find a family of his own.

Robbie has a wonderful temperament. He is friendly, loving and enjoys human company.

He likes to be involved in family life and is always happy to join in whatever is going on, whether that’s playtime in the garden, a walk, or simply relaxing with his people.

He mixes beautifully with other dogs and enjoys making new canine friends. He is also comfortable around cats and has been raised alongside a variety of animals in his foster environment.

As a young puppy, Robbie is curious, intelligent and eager to learn. He is being raised in a home environment where he is exposed to everyday household sounds, routines and experiences, giving him an excellent foundation for life in his future home.

Robbie would suit a wide variety of households, including families, couples, older adopters and homes with existing pets.

Most importantly, he is looking for a family who will continue his training, provide plenty of love and include him as part of the family.

He will travel on DEFRA registered transport to you with vaccinations, microchip, blood tests and a pet passport, together with ongoing rescue back-up for life.

Robbie is a sweet little boy with a bright future ahead of him and is sure to make a wonderful companion for a lucky family.

WhatsApp us for an informal chat and to meet Robbie on live video.

name: Chase
description:
Chase is a medium-sized cross-breed of approximately 9 months old.

Chase is currently living in a cage-free foster home in Bulgaria and is ready to travel to the UK via DEFRA-approved transport.

Chase was rescued as a young puppy and has grown into a gentle, sweet-natured boy. He has a naturally shy personality and can be cautious when meeting new people or experiencing new situations, but there is absolutely no malice in him.

He simply needs a little patience and understanding while he learns to trust.

He is a calm, non-reactive dog who prefers a quieter lifestyle and would thrive in a home where he can settle at his own pace. Chase is not demanding and is happy to relax nearby once he feels comfortable and secure.

One of Chase’s favourite things is the company of other dogs. He mixes beautifully with dogs of all sizes and gains confidence from having canine companions around him.

He is particularly gentle with smaller dogs and puppies and would happily live with another friendly resident dog.
