Gesztenye is a beautiful 2-year-old medium-sized brindle girl with the sweetest soul. She adores people, loves playing with other dogs and greets everyone she meets with a wagging tail and a hopeful smile.

For over two years, Gesztenye and her sister Zserbo have shared everything. They were rescued together from a kill shelter when they were only a few weeks old. They grew up side by side, slept in the same kennel, and waited together for someone to finally choose them.

Now Zserbo’s dream has come true. She has found a wonderful family in the UK.

But little Gesztenye will soon watch her sister leave… and for the first time in her life, she will be alone.

She has so much love to give and asks for so little in return – just a family to call her own.

Gesztenye is friendly with dogs and would happily live with another canine companion. She is affectionate, playful and kind natured, and can also live with older dog-savvy children.

She’s looking for a home where she will be part of family life and not left alone for long periods.

Like all rescue dogs, Gesztenye will need time, patience and love, but in return she will give you her whole heart.

Gesztenye is currently in Hungary and is ready to travel to the UK as soon as her forever family finds her.

She is spayed, fully vaccinated, treated for parasites, comes with and EU pet passport.

name: Cleo
description:
Cleo is an adorable 11-month-old small mixed breed girl looking for a loving forever home. She and her three siblings were found abandoned as tiny puppies, all in very poor condition, frightened and unsure of the world around them.

With their parents unknown and their future uncertain, all they had was each other.

Thankfully, Cleo has blossomed into a wonderful young dog. Although naturally a little shy when meeting new people or experiencing new situations, she is incredibly sweet, gentle, and affectionate once she feels safe.

Her confidence continues to grow every day.

She loves playing with other dogs and enjoys spending time with people she knows and trusts. Cleo would thrive in a calm, patient home where she can continue building her confidence at her own pace.

In return, she will reward her family with unwavering loyalty and love.

Cleo could happily live with another friendly well-balanced dog and she has all the potential to live with cats, too.

As a small-sized girl, Cleo would make a lovely companion for someone looking for a gentle, kind-hearted dog.

She comes spayed, microchipped, fully vaccinated and with an EU pet passport.

name: Apollo
description:
Meet Apollo – a gentle soul ready for a new life.

Apollo, a 3.5-year-old medium size cross-breed boy, whose life until now has been far from kind, has finally been freed from a life lived on a chain. Yet somehow, despite everything, he has held onto his sweetness, his trust, and his huge heart.

Apollo is incredibly human-centred, affectionate, and loving — the kind of dog who just wants to be close to people and soak up kindness.

He is wonderfully sociable with other dogs, big and small, and plays beautifully and politely with them. He’s also an absolute dream at the vets, calm and cooperative — everyone who meets him falls for his sweet nature.

He even has the potential to live with cats; in his previous life, he used to sleep in his dog house with a cat companion, sharing warmth and comfort.

He travels nicely in the car, walks well on the lead, and is more than ready to start discovering what family life means.

Currently, Apollo lives in boarding kennels, hoping that one day someone will finally choose him.

Apollo has so much love to give — he just needs someone who will finally give him the life he has always deserved. ?

Apollo comes neutered, fully vaccinated, microchipped, and with an EU pet passport.

He is ready to travel from Hungary as soon as his family is found.

name: Ariel
description:
Ariel is a 6-year-old small-medium sized girl with a big personality and an even bigger heart. This feisty little terrier has been waiting in the shelter for over 3 years… far longer than any dog should have to wait.

Ariel is full of character – a true terrier spirit. She’s lively, expressive and not afraid to let you know when she’s excited – it’s all part of her charm!

She is affectionate with people and loves children, happily soaking up attention and enjoying being part of the action. Ariel forms lovely bonds and will be a loyal and loving companion to her family.

With other dogs, she is friendly with most and enjoys their company, though like many terriers, she appreciates respectful introductions and a good match in energy.

After spending such a long time in the shelter, Ariel truly deserves a home where she can finally relax, feel safe, and be loved every day.

She would love a family who will embrace her fun personality, include her in their lives, and give her the attention she’s been missing for so long.

Ariel is in Hungary, ready to travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her.

name: Loki
description:
Loki, a beautiful 2 year old Siberian Husky needs a new home through no fault of his own.

The owner has serious health problems and is unable to give him the care and attention he needs and deserves. He is spending more and more time in kennels which is far from ideal.

Loki is a lovely boy, he loves his toys and he has a kind nature. He is currently the only dog in the household, but he is friendly with dogs and wants to play on walks so he has the potential to live with another friendly dog.

He is also used to living with older children.

He is fully vaccinated and microchipped and up to date with flea and wormingtreatments.

Loki is in Chorley, Lancashire where he is visitable upon arrangement.

name: Jenny
description:
Jenny is a 10 year old female Airedale Terrier Cross with a heartbreaking past and a heart full of hope. For seven long years, she was left chained outside without shelter or kindness, while the world looked away.

Her suffering only came to light by chance — her rescuers were returning another dog when they saw her standing there, neglected and desperate.

Jenny’s eyes lit up as if she knew this was her moment, and when her owner was asked to surrender her, he did so without hesitation.

Since that day, Jenny has been safe, but her home has been a kennel. A whole year has passed, and she is still waiting for the love she has never truly known.

Jenny is gentle and people-oriented. She loves her walks and is good on the lead, though she can be a little strong at times. She enjoys chasing a ball and, while she isn’t interested in making doggy friends, she’s content as long as her space is respected.

Jenny would be happiest as the only dog in the home so she doesn’t have to share attention or space.

She is spayed, fully vaccinated, and travels with her EU pet passport — ready to start the new chapter she so deserves.

Jenny has lost so many years, but it’s not too late for her to find happiness! All she wants now is to spend her golden years knowing comfort, kindness, and love.

Could you give her the forever home she has waited a lifetime for?

Fully vaccinated, spayed, microchipped, with an EU pet passport. Ready to travel.

name: Beigli
description:
Beigli is a 1.5 year-old medium-sized crossbreed boy with a beautiful soul. Born in an abandoned property alongside his six siblings, little Beigli’s life began in heartbreaking circumstances.

His mum was desperately trying to keep her babies alive while she herself was painfully thin and starving.

At just three weeks old, the family was rescued and brought to safety.

The puppies grew up, one by one they found their forever homes, and today only two remain: Beigli and his sister Maggie.

At just 1.5 years old, Beigli has already spent almost his entire life waiting.

He adores people, loves playing with other dogs, and has the kind, gentle nature that makes everyone fall in love with him.

All Beigli dreams of is a family to call his own. A warm bed. Daily walks. Someone to greet with a wagging tail and endless devotion.

He can live with older dog-savvy children and can be cat tested for the right applicant.

Beigli is in Hungary and is ready to travel to the UK as soon as the right family finds him.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, treated for parasites, with an EU pet passport.

name: Paddy
description:
Paddy is a 9 year old male medium cross-breed currently in Scotland.

He is neutered and settled into home life following rescue from a shelter environment.

Paddy is affectionate, calm and people-focused once he has built trust. He forms strong bonds with his primary carers and enjoys close companionship, but can be wary of unfamiliar people. Slow and controlled introductions are recommended.

He prefers a quiet environment and can become overwhelmed in busy households or where there are frequent visitors.

Paddy is housetrained, can be left alone and walks well on lead. He enjoys regular walks and time outdoors, although he can be sensitive to traffic and may require reassurance around vehicles.

He travels well once in the car but may need assistance getting in. He is comfortable with routine handling and enjoys grooming.

Paddy can live with other calm and respectful dogs, although he prefers his own space for resting. He may also be able to live with a cat following careful introductions.

He would suit a quiet, adult-only home in a rural or semi-rural location. An experienced adopter who can provide a calm, structured environment and allow him time to build trust would be ideal.

name: Maggie
description:
Maggie is a beautiful, smaller-medium-sized 2 year old Cross-Breed girl who may be a little shy when meeting new people, but give her some time and patience, and she’ll have the chance to show you what a lovely companion she can be.

She gets on brilliantly with other dogs and could happily share her home with canine friends. She could also live with older children who understand that some dogs need a little time to feel comfortable.

We can also cat test her if needed for the right applicant.

Maggie’s story began in difficult circumstances. She and her six siblings were born in an abandoned property, where their emaciated mum struggled to feed her puppies.

The little family was taken in by the local shelter when the pups were just three weeks old.

All seven puppies were stunningly beautiful, but heartbreakingly, two are still waiting for their forever families. Maggie is now two years old, and it’s time her own happy ending began.

Maggie’s spayed, fully vaccinated and ready to travel once the right family is found.

Home check and adoption fee apply. Full RBU provided.

name: Perine
description:
Perine is an 11 month old female small cross-breed currently in the East Midlands.

She is spayed, iElisa negative and weighs approximately 9kg.

Perine is a confident and outgoing young dog who enjoys being involved in day-to-day activities. She is playful, inquisitive and affectionate with people once settled.

She is friendly with men and women and has been positive around children. Due to her excitable nature, she would be best suited to a home with older children.

Perine gets along well with other dogs and benefits from their presence. A calm resident dog would help support her development and confidence.

She can be vocal when greeting visitors but settles quickly and seeks interaction.

Perine is still in the early stages of training. She may mouth during play and will require continued training and guidance as she matures.

She is housetrained, sleeps well overnight and accepts a lead, although she will benefit from ongoing lead training to build consistency and confidence.

Perine is used to a quieter environment and may find busy or high-traffic areas overwhelming.

Perine would suit a home able to provide structure, routine and ongoing training. A secure garden and a patient, active household will support her continued development.

name: Suzy
description:
Suzy is a 1.5 year old female Cross-Breed, medium in size. She was rescued exactly a year ago from horrid circumstances, having been thrown into a yard with her brother, Tommy, at just a few weeks of age.

They lived on piles of rubbish, frequently escaping due to inadequate fencing and roaming the streets among busy traffic, constantly in danger. When rescued, they were emaciated and full of parasites.

Suzy has grown to be a kind-natured, healthy girl who is active and playful according to her age. She is medium-sized and has a lovely cheeky character. She loves people and is very friendly around kids, too.

She is also playful and happy around other dogs.

Suzy is perhaps slightly more reserved than her brother and enjoys doggie company a lot. She loves to play and run with her mates.

Suzy would be happiest in a family where she is not left alone for extended periods and there is time for her training. We want her to be treated as a treasured member of the family and be taken on nice adventures. She will need time to settle into her new home and get used to her environment.

Suzy could happily live with another friendly and playful dog or dogs but may also be happy being the only dog and the centre of attention in the family.

As with all rescue dogs, she will need time, patience, love, and commitment from her adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog.

Experience with rescue dogs is preferred.

Suzy is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK as soon as the right family is found for her.

She comes spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA-approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Mary
description:
Mary is a 3.5 year old female German Shepherd Cross. Originally from Romania, Mary was found all alone when tiny and taken to a private shelter where she was very lonely.

Mary spent three years there before she came to foster with a vet in Newmarket, Suffolk.

Mary has blossomed; she loves life and all she wants to do is shake hands with you. She can be a bit nervous when she meets someone new, but once she knows there is nothing to worry about, she is fine.

She is so friendly, affectionate, and loves cuddles. Mary is kind and calm but also enjoys a good run in a safe area. She is good on the lead and weighs 26 kg.

Mary is just a very special girl. She is looking for a home with someone who has plenty of time for her and can offer her an active life.

She is good with dogs, cats, and hens. She loves the car and will hop in and out with no problem. No children are preferred so she can be the centre of your world.

Mary has a lopsided face, possibly born like that, but it cannot be confirmed. It makes her all the more endearing. She is in foster with a vet who has given her a clean bill of health.

Mary is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and has a passport. You will not find a nicer dog than Mary.

Adoption fee £500. A home check is required, and there is rescue backup. Please consider this absolutely delightful girl.

name: Junior
description:
Junior is a 3-year-old male Dachshund Cross. He was rescued from a deprived area of Hungary in very poor condition and has since been given a second chance at life. Despite everything he has been through, he has remained a sweet and affectionate little dog.

He has been waiting patiently while other dogs around him have found homes, yet he has somehow been overlooked. This is especially sad because he is described as a lovable and funny boy who truly enjoys human company.

More than anything, he is simply longing to be part of a family of his own.

Junior walks nicely on the lead and enjoys getting out and about. He loves people and shows a gentle and friendly nature in his interactions. His kind temperament also means he is patient when around children.

When it comes to other dogs, Junior’s preference is for female dogs. He would be happiest living with a spayed female companion or as the only dog in the home where he can soak up all the attention.

This flexibility means he could suit different home setups, as long as his social preferences are respected.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, and microchipped, which gives his future family reassurance about his health care. He also has an EU pet passport, making his travel arrangements clear and straightforward.

A home check and adoption fee will apply, and full rescue back-up is provided for added support.

Junior is a small dog at approximately 10 kg, making him a manageable size for many households. His journey has not been easy, but his gentle nature and cheerful personality have stayed intact.

He is ready to leave his difficult past behind and finally enjoy the comfort and security of a loving home.

name: Sky
description:
Meet Sky, a young 1 year old Griffon Niverna girl with the gentlest soul who is still learning that the world can be kind.

Sky came into our care in Galicia, northern Spain, along with her two siblings after a hunter no longer wanted them and threatened to kill them if no one stepped in.

Thankfully they were saved in time — but Sky is now the only one still waiting for her forever home.

She is around 1.5 years old and a Griffon Nivernais type. Sky is currently underweight at approximately 17kg (she should be closer to 20kg), and we are working on building her strength, confidence, and trust in humans again.

Despite everything she has been through, Sky is incredibly gentle. She is good with other dogs and children, and with time, patience, and kindness, she will truly blossom into a loyal and loving companion.

Sky would benefit from a calm, understanding home where she can continue to gain confidence at her own pace and finally feel safe. Must have a secure garden.

She is fully prepared for travel — vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, and spayed — and can travel to the U.K. or across Europe to the right home.

If you can offer Sky the second chance she so desperately deserves, she will reward you with quiet loyalty and love.

As with all of our dogs, she comes with full rescue back-up.

name: Tango
description:
Tango is a 2 year old male Cross-Breed. He was saved from the streets with his 4 siblings and their mum, who is a Dachshund cross.

Tango is a very kind-natured boy—friendly, affectionate, and playful. He has a beautiful, friendly look and a well-proportioned build. He loves people and enjoys a lively, playful lifestyle.

He is very social with his doggie mates and plays well with them.

Tango would be best suited for a family where he is not left alone for extended periods and is treated as a family member. He would love to go on nice adventures! He will need time to settle into his new home, and his training will need to be continued.

He could live happily with another friendly, playful dog or as the only dog in the home, being the centre of attention.

As with all rescue dogs, he will need time, patience, love, and commitment from his adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog. Experience with rescue dogs is preferred.

Tango is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK once the right family is found for him.

He comes fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA-approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Damian
description:
Meet Damian, a young cross-breed dog with a gentle soul who is slowly learning to trust the world around him.

Damian is around 2 years old and was rescued from another shelter after being found wandering alone on a road, likely having been abandoned. His early life was not kind to him, and he arrived shy and fearful, unsure of people and new experiences.

Despite this, Damian is making steady progress. With patience and care from the team at Rescates Garatuxa in northern Spain, he is beginning to come out of his shell.

Recently, he took an important step forward by going for a walk outside on a harness with a volunteer – a big milestone for a dog like him.

We believe Damian did not receive proper nutrition or care as a puppy, which has affected his physical development. This is sadly not uncommon in hunting dogs.

What he needs now is a home that can offer him time, understanding, and gentle guidance as he continues to build confidence.

Damian is good with other dogs and would likely benefit from a calm, stable environment, possibly with another confident dog to help him feel secure. He would suit an experienced and patient adopter who understands that trust takes time.

He will be fully prepared for travel – vaccinated, microchipped, neutered, and with his passport ready – and can travel to the U.K. or across Europe to the right home.

If you can offer Damian the quiet, compassionate home he needs, you will see him slowly blossom into a loyal and loving companion.

As with all of our dogs, he comes with full rescue back-up.

name: Malna
description:
Malna is a 3 year old crossbreed girl, she was dumped on the roadside along with her sister at about 2.5 months of age. She is medium size, weight: 15 kg, shoulder height: 44 cm.

Malna is a lovely girl, she is friendly and kind and loves everyone. She is energetic and playful and sociable around her doggie mates.

She enjoys nothing more than running around in the fields with other dogs, playing a chase. She cooperates nicely with humans too and is very kind with humans.

She enjoys car rides and is good around children too. She also walks nicely on the lead.

Malna would be best suited for a family where she is not left alone for extended periods and she is included in her family’s activities. She would be happiest in an active family, she would happily be your company on long walks, hikes and holidays.

Older dog savvy children will be considered.

Malna would probably be happiest living with another playful dog but she could also live happily as the only dog and the centre of attention in her home.

As all rescue dogs, she will need time, patience, love and commitment from her adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog.

Malna is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK as soon as the right family is found for her.

She comes spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to Home Check and Adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Henry
description:
Meet Henry, a 4 year old male medium-sized Cross-Breed currently based in Basingstoke, UK. Born in May 2021, Henry has sadly been waiting since April 2022 to find his forever home, and honestly, it’s baffling because he is an absolute gem.

Henry is a lovely, friendly boy who adores people and truly enjoys companionship. He is great with other dogs and can also live happily with cats, making him a wonderfully versatile family companion.

Thanks to his gentle and sociable nature, he could also possibly live with children aged 10 years and over.

Henry is neutered and fully vaccinated and is more than ready to leave kennel life behind. He would love a home where he can finally settle, feel secure, and enjoy the love and attention he has been patiently waiting for.

An ideal home for Henry would be with a family or individual who can offer stability, affection, and regular walks. He has waited far too long for his chance and truly deserves a loving forever home to call his own.

A home check and adoption donation apply. Full rescue backup and support are provided throughout the adoption process and for the lifetime of the dog.

name: Buddy
description:
Buddy is a 7 year old, neutered, fully vaccinated dog weighing approximately 20kg. He was rescued from a Romanian kill shelter in April 2023 and has since shown himself to be a curious and gentle companion with a moderate energy level.

Buddy is already housetrained and walks well on a lead.

Prior to coming to foster in the UK, Buddy was a curious dog, happy to greet strangers, but sadly his foster placement didn’t work out and now Buddy is struggling in kennels.

He is a gentle dog who needs equally gentle, kind adopters who are willing to rebuild his trust in people. In Romania he was good with the other dogs that he shared a kennel with.

Buddy needs help to adapt to living in a home. He’d be happy as the only dog or with calm, kind doggy companions. We are looking for a rural or semi-rural home because, once settled and able to trust again, Buddy will be happy to go on long walks.

He also needs a garden because he enjoys being outdoors. Ideally any adopters will have previous experience of Romanian dogs, and live within an hour or so of the kennels for several meets & greets.

However, transport can be arranged for the right adopters.

Please note Buddy does not have a tail. We are unsure if he was born like this or if something happened before he was rescued.

Full rescue backup and support throughout the adoption process and for the lifetime of the dog.

name: Agika
description:
Agika is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed. She is a small cross-breed girl looking for her forever family.

This little girl has suffered so much in her short life; still, she is a little miracle. She was rescued from a heartbreaking situation where she had been kept on a short chain that had grown deep into her neck.

Once she was released, the chain had to be surgically removed.

Despite a truly rough start, Agika is a real sweetheart—loving, affectionate, and full of life. When she was rescued, she was timid and afraid of the world.

However, she soon left her old self behind, learned that some people can be trusted, and has grown into a joyful dog who loves life, loves other dogs, and now loves people too.

She walks nicely on the lead and looks forward to her walks, which she does not get many of.

She loves attention and will happily accept any amount of cuddles or affection. Agika is ready to start a new life in a safe, loving home where she will be treated the way she has always deserved.

She wants to be part of the family and discover all the things she has not yet had the chance to see or sniff.

Experience with rescue dogs is preferred but is not essential, as all applications are assessed individually.

Agika is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her. She comes spayed and fully vaccinated, with an EU pet passport.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full rescue backup is provided.

name: Eddie and Billy
description:
Eddie is a no-age-given male Cross-Breed. He and his brother Billy are bonded brothers who are looking for a new home together. They are currently being fostered in Hertfordshire after the tragic loss of their owner.

The boys each weigh 12kg and have very friendly personalities. They love being around people and enjoy spending time with other dogs. Their affectionate nature makes them enjoyable companions.

Eddie has short hair, while Billy has a longer and fluffier coat. Both dogs enjoy their walks and love having the opportunity to run around and do zoomies. They would benefit from a home where they can continue to enjoy an active lifestyle.

They are looking for an active family, couple, or individual who can offer them a permanent and loving home. As bonded brothers, they would need to remain together so they can continue to enjoy each other’s company.

Their close relationship is an important part of their lives.

The boys are neutered, vaccinated, and microchipped. They are being cared for by The Little Rescue while they wait for the right adopters to come forward. A home check and adoption fee will apply as part of the adoption process.

attributes.Breed: Staffordshire bull terrier cross labrador retriever

name: Zelda
description:
Meet Zelda, a 2 year old female Staffordshire Bull Terrier cross Labrador Retriever — a brave and beautiful girl who has survived unimaginable cruelty yet still greets the world with love.

She came from hell. Zelda spent her early life chained so short she couldn’t even stand, the chain cutting deep into her neck. Despite such cruelty, she never lost her spark. Once freed, she greeted her rescuers with a wagging tail and a forgiving heart.

Now safe, she’s blossomed into an energetic, happy-natured girl. She’s medium-sized, affectionate, and adores people.

Zelda gets along well with other dogs — though she can be a bit boisterous in her play — and would thrive either as an only dog or with a friendly, tolerant companion.

In the kennel, she doesn’t get the exercise or freedom she craves, and she’s longing for a home where she can run, play, and finally just be a dog. She loves her walks, though she does pull on the lead, simply excited to be out exploring the world she missed for so long.

Zelda would suit an active home that can give her the exercise, structure, and affection she craves, so her joyful spirit can shine at long last. Older children will be considered.

Zelda has endured pain no animal should ever know. She deserves a life full of love, freedom, and fun.

Fully vaccinated, spayed, microchipped, with an EU pet passport. Ready to travel.

name: Shadow
description:
Lovely girl Shadow is a 2 year old medium sized mixed breed who has recently been saved by us from the streets.

She has a soft black and white short coat, and she is a very loving, affectionate and playful girl with her pal Max, who sleeps in her kennel.

Shadow is good with all the other dogs once introduced, but can be a bit of a slow burner to begin with, until she knows she is safe.

Shadow walks very well on her lead and we think that she is suitable for a family with older children with or without another friendly dog.

Shadow is not cat tested but we can do that if required.

Shadow is ready to travel now for the right family.

Great with people and dogs. gentle nature, and is obedient, loving and a pretty girl

name: Trixy
description:
Trixy is a 1.5-year-old, smaller medium crossbreed girl with a heart full of love. She was rescued from the streets alongside her mum (a Dachshund cross) and four siblings.

Three of the pups, including Trixy, are still waiting for their happy ending in a shelter in Hungary.

Trixy is a lively, playful young girl who sometimes shows a little shyness at first. But once she feels safe, her sweet, cuddly side shines through — she only needs love, patience, and kindness to truly thrive.

She adores playing with her doggie friends and gets along well with them.

She is friendly with people, including children, and enjoys her walks, trotting happily on the lead. Trixy would be happiest in a family where she isn’t left alone for long hours and is treated as a true member of the family — joining in on adventures, cuddles, and daily life.

She could easily share her home with another playful, gentle dog, or be the only pet, soaking up all the love and attention. Like all rescue dogs, she will need time, patience, and commitment from her new family to settle and blossom into the wonderful companion she is meant to be.

Trixy is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK once her perfect family is found. She will come spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, and with an EU pet passport.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Cosmo
description:
Cosmo is a medium sized, mixed breed boy, around 1 year old.

Cosmo is currently in Cyprus and ready to travel.

Cosmo is growing up in the shelter and it’s not fair. He has been there since he was 6 months old and needs to get out asap so he can start living his life.

He arrived with his mum and siblings after they were confiscated from the owner.

Cosmo is a lovely, friendly boy and is patiently waiting for his chance at life. He should be enjoying life in a loving home, cared for and cherished, warm at night instead of sleeping in a concrete floor and looking at the same 4 walls of a kennel.

After some initial excitement, Cosmo is beginning to walk well on the leash. He is medium sized but strong so will need someone who can handle him. He’s great with other dogs, strangers, and children.

He’s far too young to spend his days in a shelter. He can live with a single person, a couple, or a family.

Cosmo is located in Cyprus and, if adopted in the UK, will travel with a passport and has been tested for infectious diseases. He is fully vaccinated and will be castrated.

name: Sully
description:
Sully is a 5 year old medium size male cross breed. He looks like someone accidentally shrunk a Rottweiler in the wash. He’s handsome, compact, and has mastered the art of looking at you as if he’s contemplating the meaning of life.

Sully’s story didn’t begin so happily, he was surrendered in Hungary by a British family along with several other dogs.

They arrived frightened of people, fearful of new experiences, and clearly hadn’t been shown the love, kindness and guidance that every dog deserves.

For Sully the world was a scary place initially. But then he saw people who were kind to him, spoke gently, and gave him time. And it didn’t take long for him to realise that not all humans let you down.

Today Sully is a completely different dog, he enjoys life and likes human company, and although he still has his moments of insecurity, he is now curious and not fearful of the world around him.

He is a loyal, kind natured boy, quite placid in temperament. He isn’t a high energy dog either who would need endless adventures and entertainment all through the day, but he will happily join you on your walks and then enjoy home time sharing the sofa with you.

What he really wants though is a family who won’t give up on him.

Sully is friendly with most dogs with sensible introductions, very excitable dogs are probably not the best match for him but he could happily live with a friendly placid dog.

He is friendly around children, too, but he would probably be best suited to an adult-only home as he is not used to the noise and chaos that can come with young children.

We can cat test him for the right applicant.

He would really love to leave his shelter days behind and start a new life.

And he comes with a special bonus in that he understands English!

Sully is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once the right family is found for him.

He comes neutered, microchipped, fully vaccinated, with an EU pet passport.

name: Meeka
description:
Meeka is a small sized (14kg), black and white female wadi dog who is currently in Oman. She was 1 year old in February 2026 and was rescued as a newborn puppy.

Her mum had been sadly shot and died so a local rescuer took in Meeka and her siblings and hand reared them. Meeka came into our care when she was 3 months old.

Meeka currently lives in a boarding facility and the volunteers walk and socialize with her every week. She is always very happy and excited to see them and enjoys going out for a walk.

She enjoys sniffing new smells, and having a dig in any mud she finds. She is wary of trucks and large vehicles that pass by though.

She gets along well with the other dogs in boarding, and although she has never lived with cats, she has shown no prey drive with the cats she has met.

She would love a home with people who have the time and energy for a young dog. She is healthy, fully vaccinated, microchipped, spayed and rabies titer tested so is ready to leave Oman now.

We will test her for Brucella before she leaves Oman.

name: Kormi
description:
Meet Kormi, a 7-year-old, 17 kg terrier-type boy with a scruffy black-and-white coat, a cute white chest, and the funniest little pointy ears! But it’s his big personality that really makes him stand out!

Kormi ended up at a public shelter due to poor living conditions, so it’s fair to say life hasn’t always been kind to him, and now he’s waiting behind bars for someone to give him the happy ending he deserves.

But this cheeky little chap is full of life, energy and character! He loves pottering about, keeping busy and, when he’s really excited, can even spin around on his back! He’s guaranteed to make you smile!

Kormi is always delighted to get out of his kennel for a walk and behaved beautifully on the lead, paying little attention to passing dogs. He’s also friendly, affectionate and cuddly, and absolutely loves being close to people.

Kormi is a wonderful little boy with plenty of personality! He is looking for someone who will appreciate his cheeky, spirited nature and welcome a little fun and mischief into their everyday life.

Kormi is neutered, fully vaccinated, and ready to travel once the right home is found for him.

name: Remy
description:
Remy is the kind of dog who will fill your life with movement, joy, and endless energy.

He was found in a crowded municipal pound – one of many dogs, waiting, overlooked. Like so many Bretons, he was once a hunting dog… and when he was no longer useful, he was simply left behind. No goodbye. No second thought.

Despite everything, he is still full of love, life, and trust in humans.

This handsome young Breton is incredibly affectionate with people and fantastic with other dogs. He’s also great with children (8+), making him a wonderful companion for an active family.

While he enjoys cuddles and attention, Remy’s true passion is being outside – running, playing, exploring, and making the most of every moment. He is 50 cm tall and weighs 14 kg.

Remy is a lively, high-energy boy who thrives on activity. He will need a home that understands his needs and can provide plenty of daily exercise, stimulation, and enrichment.

Long walks, playtime with other dogs, and space to run will make him the happiest version of himself.

Very friendly with humans, dogs, and childrenYoung, active, and full of lifeLoves running and playing above all elseAffectionate, but not a couch potatoFood-motivated (he LOVES his meals!)Can be protective over food while eating, so must be fed separatelyRemy doesn’t show obvious signs of trauma – he’s simply a sensitive, energetic dog who experiences the world with enthusiasm. He’s not dominant or submissive with other dogs; he just happily does his own thing and joins in play when it suits him.

Remy would thrive in an active household that can match his energy and give him structure, exercise, and fun. A home with another playful dog would be a bonus, but is not essential. Most importantly, he needs adopters who understand that young working breeds like the Breton require both physical and mental stimulation.

With the right home, Remy will be an incredibly rewarding companion – loyal, loving, and full of personality.

All of our dogs have an international passport (unless born in the UK) and are microchipped. They are fully vaccinated for standard diseases as well as rabies and kennel cough.

All dogs are blood tested for infectious diseases including Leishmaniasis, Dirofilaria, Ehrlichia, Babesia, Anaplasma, Lyme and Brucella canis.

All dogs, unless there are medical or behavioural reasons to not do so, will be sterilised. Remy is neutered. Full medical information will be provided upon successful application.

Could you be the one to give Remy the life he’s been waiting for?

Adoption contract and fee, homecheck, and lifetime rescue back-up apply.

name: Bracken
description:
Meet Bracken – a sweet, soulful young 2 year old Breton boy who is patiently waiting for the family he can finally call his own. He is 48cm tall and weighs 14 kg.

Bracken is an ex-hunting dog with a gentle, affectionate nature. Despite his working background, he shows little sign of trauma (comparatively to other dogs) and has adapted beautifully to shelter life.

What he wants most in the world is simple: people to love, and to give him what a Breton needs: exercise and enrichment.

He is often found waiting at his kennel door – not desperate to leave, but hoping that whoever passes by might stop for a moment of attention and cuddles. Once you give him that connection, he completely blossoms.

Affectionate, calm, and people-focusedFriendly with other dogsGood with children (8+ due to size/energy)Active and enjoys his walks and exploringContent to play independently if no humans are available, but always prefers human company

An active family who enjoys daily walks and outdoor timePeople who are home often and want a close companionA stable, loving environment where he is included in family lifeAdopters who understand the needs of a Breton (a working breed with energy and intelligence) and who will provide appropriate enrichmentHe will be a wonderful match for someone looking for a loyal, affectionate companion rather than a very independent dog.

Bracken is fully ready to travel (please see below) and to start his new life.

Bracken is currently at our shelter in Cordoba in southern Spain but will be coming to a UK foster home soon.

All of our dogs have an international passport (unless born in the UK) and are microchipped. They are fully vaccinated for standard diseases as well as rabies and kennel cough.

All dogs are blood tested for infectious diseases including Leishmaniasis, Dirofilaria, Ehrlichia, Babesia, Anaplasma, Lyme and Brucella Canis.

All dogs, unless there are medical or behavioural reasons to not do so, will be sterilised. Bracken is neutered. Please note that we will advise medical results and treatments upon successful application.

Adoption contract and fee, homecheck and lifetime RBU (rescue back-up) apply as standard.

name: Nashi
description:
Nashi is a 2-year-old medium-sized girl (20 kg) who is waiting for her chance at a public shelter in Hungary.

She is the sweetest natured, friendly girl who is very affectionate and loves all people she meets! She walks beautifully on the lead and she’s already doing brilliantly at overcoming new challenges.

A lovable dog like Nashi deserves so much more than life behind bars.

She is waiting for her special person who wants to share their life with her and is happy to give her all the love and care she has missed her first two years of life.

Nashi is compatible with other dogs and can also live with older dog savvy children.

name: Nala
description:
Nala is a 4 year old female Cross-Breed, D.O.B. 14/09/2021, who was rescued in Romania in September 2024 along with her 9 puppies. She is a sweet, gentle dog who is still learning to trust people.

She is naturally cautious and nervous around new people but is gradually opening up to her foster and showing her true nature.

Nala would benefit from a calm, quiet environment to help her feel safe and take things at her own pace. Ideally, she needs to live with another calm, confident resident dog or dogs who can help her gain trust in her surroundings.

Nala weighs approximately 20kg and stands 50cm tall from floor to withers. She is spayed, fully vaccinated, and enjoys the company of other dogs. She takes no notice of cats. Due to Nala’s shyness, we recommend a home without children.

Nala can be left for a few hours as long as she has the company of other dogs. She is happy to sleep downstairs in her basket at night.

Nala is currently in Cullompton, Devon. However, transport can be arranged for the right adopter.

Stray2Me is a UK registered charity (No. 1186687), with trustees and volunteers across the country.

Home check and adoption donation apply. Full rescue backup and support provided.

name: Balto
description:
Little Balto was abandoned and was living the life of strays in a village with his two siblings when he was rescued.

Sadly their beautiful mum is still out there, too frightened of people to be caught.

At just 4 months old, Balto is a sweet-natured little boy with a beautiful, smiling face and a heart to match. He’s soft, cuddly and friendly with everyone he meets.

He is playful and kind, loves other dogs and would be delighted to have a canine friend in his new home. He could also live with older, dog savvy children.

Balto is expected to be medium size when fully grown and is ready to travel to his new home once the right family is found for him.

He has his whole life ahead of him and he’s ready to start a new chapter — one filled with love, safety and cuddles.

name: Mocca
description:
I’m not the shyest dog you’ll meet, but right now… I am a very confused one.

When I was just a tiny puppy, I was found in Romania with my brother and sister. We didn’t have much—no warm beds, no full bowls, just each other. Then we were taken to a shelter.

That’s where the older, wiser dogs told us stories… stories about a magical place far away where dogs had families. Real families.

They said dogs slept in warm beds, never went hungry, and went on adventures—sniffing grass, chasing leaves, even watching squirrels.

They said you needed a “golden ticket” to get there. And somehow… we got one.

We came to the UK. And for a little while, I thought the stories were true. I had a home. I had people. I had hope.

But then… after just a few weeks… they decided they didn’t want me anymore.

They said I guarded my food and toys. And maybe I did. When you grow up with nothing, it’s hard to understand that things won’t be taken away. I held on too tightly… because I was scared of losing everything again.

The girls here are helping me every day, and I’m getting better. I’m starting to understand that food comes back, toys come back… that I don’t have to be afraid anymore.

I absolutely love humans. I’ve had some good training, I can walk nicely on the lead, and I’m good with other dogs too.

Every time a volunteer walks past my kennel, I get so excited. I think, “This is it. I’m going home.” But I always have to come back… and it breaks my heart a little more each time.

So I’m asking—please. Share my story far and wide. Someone out there must have space for me. I don’t need perfect… I just need a chance.

name: Lika
description:
Lika is a deaf young dog whose foster family writes , she is one of the sweetest-natured dogs they have ever met. She is full of life, always looking for her next adventure, and brings a constant sense of fun wherever she goes.

She is a happy, confident pup with no signs of trauma. Lika approaches the world with complete trust and enthusiasm and absolutely adores people. She gives the most wonderful cuddles and thrives on affection.

Because she is deaf, Lika doesn’t always pick up on signals from other dogs, and her play style can be very boisterous. She loves other dogs, but her unfiltered excitement can overwhelm them, especially smaller or more sensitive dogs.

She is responding well to hand signals and already knows some basic commands. Like any puppy, she can be selective at times, but she is very food-motivated, which makes training enjoyable and rewarding.

“Sit” for a treat is already spot on! Lika would suit an active home that enjoys the outdoors and can offer: Plenty of exercise Ongoing training using positive, reward-based methods. Mental stimulation and engagement.

Although it may sound surprising given her deafness, we feel that with a dedicated handler she could even enjoy activities like agility, where visual communication is key.

She is not destructive, but she does love to carry things around and enjoys her toys and chew bones. Lika has not been tested with cats.

We feel Lika would be happiest: As the only dog, or with a confident, well-balanced dog who can clearly set boundaries She would particularly suit someone with experience of high-energy breeds such as Border Collies.

Lika was found abandoned in the countryside with her 5 siblings and her mother. A friend of our volunteer asked for our help. A vet took 5 of the siblings and they are now in a private shelter. We took Lika. As yet, we have been unable to secure the mother.

name: Duchess
description:
Meet Duchess our 4 ½ year old, Female, German Shepherd Cross. Unfortunately we have not had any enquires for Duchess as yet, which we simply can’t understand why.

Duchess came to us in a state of neglect, she was very thin, and had what looked like untreated sores. Through the dedication of our team she is now a much happier healthier dog.

This loving smiley dog, loves attention, and will give plenty in return. She loves her toys, and once she has found her favourite one she will carry it with her everywhere.

She is an active dog, and would suit a home that has a similar lifestyle. She loves to go for a walk, and have play. She walks ok on the lead, she can be a bit excitable to start with, but soon settles down once she has her toy to hold.

She would suit a home where she is the only animal, but could settle well in a home with older children.

name: Vera
description:
Meet Vera, our very smiley 2-year-old female Staffordshire Bull Terrier cross.

She loves to meet new people and will quite happily take any affection you can give her. She has a lot of love to give.

She walks well on the lead and will happily sit for treats. She does like to be kept active and would enjoy going out for walks with you.

We would recommend that Vera be the only animal in the home, but could settle well into a home with older children.

name: Lola, Lena, Luna and Lyra
description:
Lola, Lena, Luna and Lyra – looking for homes

Meet Luna, Lola, Lena & Lyra – Four Little Cuddle Monsters Looking for Love!

Size: Expected to be medium-sized, although their parentage is unknown

These four gorgeous girls have already had a rather tough start to life. Found abandoned between a road and a river, and without their mum, they were taken into the care of the shelter we work with.

Thankfully, their story is now taking a much happier turn, and they are ready to find families of their very own!

So, what are they like? Simply delightful! Luna, Lola, Lena and Lyra have been an absolute joy. They have been lovely with everyone they have met, including people, children and other dogs.

They are affectionate, sociable little girls who seem to love everyone and are very happy to make new friends. If you are looking for a puppy who enjoys cuddles, these girls certainly fit the bill – they are real little cuddle monsters!

They have also been surprisingly good in their kennels.

They are not destructive and have been so grateful for their blankets and comfy bedding.

Even during a storm, they coped brilliantly, showing just how lovely and adaptable these little characters can be.

These girls could suit a variety of homes, with or without another dog.

They have been great with children, so sensible, dog-aware children should be absolutely fine, provided introductions and interactions are always managed appropriately.

They have not been cat-tested, but we feel they may be able to live with cats in the right circumstances, with careful, gradual introductions and appropriate supervision.

As with any young puppy, they will need a family who has the time and patience to help them learn all about life in a home.

Toilet training is still a work in progress, although they have done very well during their time with us.

They will also need to learn about walking nicely on a lead, alongside all the other important lessons that come with growing up.

Ideally a home with a secure garden will allow them a safe space to work on their training.

We expect them to grow into lovely medium-sized dogs, but as we do not know their parentage, we cannot guarantee their adult size.

A note about their veterinary care Luna, Lola, Lena and Lyra are currently around four months old. They are not yet spayed because they are too young, so spaying will be a requirement of their adoption contract once they are old enough.

Could one of these lovely girls be the missing piece of your family?

They have already shown themselves to be affectionate, friendly and wonderfully good-natured puppies. Now they need families who will continue to help them grow, learn and discover all the wonderful things life has to offer.

If you think you could offer Luna, Lola, Lena or Lyra the loving home they deserve, please visit www.savingandrehomingstrays.org to find out more about our adoption process.

All four puppies are at our rescue in Ayr and are ready for their new homes. Adopters must be able to travel to Ayr for a meet and greet and collection.

A home check and adoption donation apply. Their new families must also be happy to fulfil the spaying requirement in their adoption contract. Please help us find these four little cuddle monsters the wonderful futures they deserve!

name: Ayaz
description:
Ayaz, 5 years old medium size cross breed male.

Ayaz is one of the 27 dogs rescued from a hoarding case back in October, a group of dogs who had never known normal life, kindness, or what it means to feel safe.

He is a gentle, sensitive boy who has already made lovely progress. Ayaz walks nicely on a lead and really enjoys getting out, often getting excited when it’s time to go for a walk.

It’s a big step for a dog with his past, and he’s embracing it more and more.

He finds comfort in other dogs and will need a home with a confident canine companion to help him feel safe and continue learning about the world.

Ayaz is still unsure when it comes to human affection. He’s not quite ready for cuddles yet and prefers to keep a little distance, but we can see the soft, trusting boy underneath.

With time, patience, and a calm environment, he will get there.

Ayaz will need a quiet home with understanding adopters who won’t rush him. A home where he can build confidence at his own pace and continue to blossom.

He may not be the dog who runs into your arms right away… but with the right family, Ayaz has everything it takes to become a truly special companion

name: Billy
description:
Our extra special boy Billy is approximately three years old and an intriguing cross breed at the very bottom end of medium.

Billy weighs twelve kilos and measures ten inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets Billy has been in our Cyprus shelter for two months.

Billy is described by our shelter manager as rather shy and enjoys a very sweet nature and is especially calm. He has a happy and jolly disposition and so enjoys his time with people.

Billy’s appearance is exceptional. His largely black torso is beautifully enhanced with a white flash to his snout along with five white tips and his chest and tummy.

Billy is a truly exceptional adoption candidate who will prove a loyal and loving companion to his forever family. Such an affable and charming little chap.

Billy enjoys his time in the car and walks nicely on his lead. He seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Bertie
description:
Our extra special boy Bertie is approximately seven years old and a medium sized hound of sorts. Bertie weighs sixteen kilos and measures fourteen inches from shoulder to paw.

Very sadly Bertie has been in our Cyprus shelter since he was two having been abandoned on the streets.

Our shelter manager describes Bertie perfectly. He has a wonderful calm personality, a little timid and would make a fabulous companion.

Having spent so much of his life waiting patiently it is now time and in fact long overdue for Bertie to secure his forever home.

Everything is correct about Bertie but for being so meek, mild and well behaved he has simply been overlooked. Such a good-looking handsome boy.

Bertie is the epitome of gentility and kindness. His adopters will be truly blessed and greatly rewarded.

Bertie enjoys his time in the car and walks nicely on the lead. He seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Rosie
description:
Our extra special girl Rosie is approximately three years old and an adorable cross breed at the very bottom of medium size.

Rosie weighs just ten kilos and measures eleven inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets Rosie has been in our Cyprus shelter for two months.

Our shelter manager describes Rosie as exceptionally well mannered. She has a wonderful bouncy personality and lights up the room. Equally she is calm and loves a cuddle.

Rosie has a unique charisma about her which makes her instantly attractive. Really the star of any show. Her appearance is sublime with her easy to manage solid black coat and subtle white flash to her chest.

If ever there was a readymade adoption candidate it’s Rosie. She is ready to fit into her forever home and donate years of happiness and gratitude to her fortunate adopters.

Rosie walks nicely on her lead and seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Obi
description:
Obi is a 5 year old male Chihuahua Cross.

Obi is a sensitive worried boy who will be looking for a kind patient home to build his confidence.

He is a fun active boy who loves his walks and playing and will looking for a new home who can match his energy levels.

Obi is looking for a calm quiet patient home where adopters will give him the space to bond and trust. He would like access to his own secure garden to help with confidence building.

He is housetrained, ok travelling, and may prefer a home with company. Obi can be worried by lots of noise and activity so would prefer a quiet home in a quiet area.

Obi can be worried when meeting new people and will require a calm quiet patient approach to making friends.

He will bond closely with those he trusts and becomes a cheeky affectionate boy! Obi may prefer an adult only home or a home where any children are older teenagers who would be happy to take a slow approach with him.

He may prefer a home with no young visiting children.

Obi has previously lived with other small dogs and has previously been described as social with other dogs. Obi can be worried by bigger dogs but is social with small dogs.

He may prefer to be the only dog in the home but could potentially live with a small confident female dog

Not suited to living with cats, birds or small animals as will chase.

Obi would like a home with an understanding of, and the time to, support him both behaviourally and emotionally. A home that understands he will need a gentle approach when making new friends.

Obi will require several meets to get to know someone.

name: Vroula
description:
Vroula is one of the 27 dogs rescued from a hoarding case back in October, and her story is one of quiet progress and gentle bravery.

She is still a very shy girl, but slowly, step by step, she is learning that the world doesn’t have to be so scary. Handling her has become much easier, and although she still keeps her distance in the playground, we are starting to see little flashes of curiosity.

Every now and then, she will come a bit closer for a treat or even allow a gentle cuddle from the children — small moments that feel huge for a dog like Vroula.

She is more wary of men than women and will need time to build trust, patience truly is key with her.

She is not yet walking on a lead, so she currently needs to be carried, but even here we see improvement as she becomes more comfortable with each passing week.

Vroula will need a calm, quiet home with patient adopters who understand that trust cannot be rushed. A home without too much pressure, where she can go at her own pace and continue building confidence.

Another calm, confident dog could really help show her the way.

She may not be the dog who runs straight into your arms on day one… but with time, kindness, and love, Vroula will get there. And when she does, it will be something very special.

name: Ron
description:
Ron is a four year old male Brittany. Ron is a very handsome boy. Small in size with a robust frame and vibrant colours.Ron is exceptionally attached to people.

He would like to spend all day by your side! He loves cuddles and caresses and has a very good appetite too whihc will be great for training!

Ron is very sociable with female dogs and but a little wary of other males, he will soon be neutered and we will see if he settles down more then.

He is a very active dog, he loves to be out in the enclosure having a run.

Ron was handed in to the shelter we work closely with in North Spain by his hunter. Ron is one of the many unwanted Spanish gun dogs.

If you are interested in giving wonderful Ron a home, he is available at Setter Brittany Pointer Rescue. Ron is in Spain and ready to travel to his forever home in the UK.

name: Snickers
description:
Meet Snickers a medium size labrador cross boy.

Snickers’ story is one of those that stays with you. He and his siblings were found in the middle of a busy highway… tiny 4-month-old puppies left to survive the unthinkable.

Sadly, not all of them made it — some were hit by cars, and one disappeared and was never found.

Four of them were rescued. Snickers was one of the lucky ones.

His siblings — Bueno, Mars, and Bounty — didn’t wait long before finding their forever homes. But Snickers is still here… still waiting.

He was always the shyest of the four, and while his journey has been slower, it has also been incredibly special to watch. Over the past 15 months, Snickers has made beautiful progress.

He now gets excited when he sees us, eagerly waiting for his lead so he can go out to the playground — his favourite place, especially when there are treats involved.

Snickers is still a sensitive boy. While he will allow touch, he doesn’t fully enjoy cuddles just yet — but that’s simply part of his journey. He is learning, growing, and gaining confidence every day.

He is great with other dogs and would benefit from a calm, understanding home that will continue to build his confidence at his own pace.

A family who sees beyond the shyness, and understands that trust takes time, will be the perfect match for him.

Snickers may not run straight into your arms… but once he lets you into his world, it will be something truly special.

After everything he has been through, he deserves his chance.

name: Takis
description:
Meet Takis a small size beagle cross boy.

Takis is around 4 years old and a true survivor. He was rescued during the devastating wildfires last July, but his story started long before that.

Most likely abandoned as a puppy, Takis grew up alone in the mountains, learning to survive the only way he could.

Food was never guaranteed — he relied on a small local tavern that only opened on weekends, and the occasional kindness of visitors staying in nearby holiday homes. It was a fragile existence, but it was all he knew.

The villages were destroyed, the land was left burnt and empty… and somehow, Takis survived. But survival wasn’t enough anymore. The tavern stopped opening, the visitors stopped coming, and suddenly there was nothing left for him.

Takis was so shy he wouldn’t let anyone come closer than a metre. It took patience, planning, and four weeks of effort — but eventually, we managed to trap him and bring him to safety.

He was diagnosed with leishmania. Thankfully, his organs were not affected, and after completing his treatment, he is now doing really well.

Today, Takis is still a shy and sensitive boy, but he has come such a long way. He enjoys being outside, walks nicely on a lead, and is even starting to play with other dogs — something we could have never imagined before.

Takis is looking for a very special home. A calm, quiet environment with people who understand that love doesn’t always look like cuddles at first.

He will need patience, kindness, and the freedom to build trust at his own pace — even if that means loving him from a little distance in the beginning.

Because one day, that distance will close.

And when it does, it will be something truly special.

Takis has survived everything life has thrown at him. Now he deserves more than survival — he deserves a home, safety, and love for the rest of his life.

No dog should spend their life in a shelter…especially not one like Takis

name: Cametito
description:
Hi… I’m Camelito a small size 4 year old cross breed boy.

I’m still learning how to be brave, but I think I’m finally ready to tell you my story.

I came from a place where there were 26 of us… all living in conditions no dog should ever experience. We were hoarded, handled badly, and taught that human hands were something to fear.

When I was rescued, I was absolutely terrified — the world felt huge and loud, and I didn’t know who I could trust.

But that was back in October… and since then, something amazing has been happening. I’ve been getting braver. Little by little. Day by day.

At first, I couldn’t even look at people without shaking. Now? I take treats from the volunteers with my tail gently wagging. I even walk up and ask for soft petting — just a little, but enough to show I’m trying.

And they tell me all the time how proud they are of me. I like hearing that… it makes me feel like maybe I really can become the confident boy everyone believes I can be.

I’m still scared of walking on the lead. It’s not the lead itself — it’s the fear of the unknown, the memories I’m trying to forget. But I’m working on it, and I’m trying so hard. I promise I’ll keep trying.

I’ve reached the point where the shelter can’t help me grow much more. I need something different now — a home. A real home. Somewhere calm and kind, with patient humans who understand that healing isn’t a straight line.

I’ll have good days and harder days… but I know I have so much potential. I know I can learn to trust completely with the right family by my side.

I’m not asking for perfection — just understanding. Just time. Just a chance.

If you’ve ever looked at a frightened dog and thought, “I wish I could show you the world isn’t such a scary place…”then maybe you’re the person I’ve been waiting for.

I’m ready to take the next step.I’m ready to try.I just need someone who believes in me.

If you think that might be you… I’m here, hoping you’ll notice me.

name: Biscuit
description:
Biscuit is a 5 year old medium/large male Cross-Breed.

Meet Biscuit, Biscuit is a very special boy with the biggest heart. He absolutely loves everyone he meets inside and out and loves to be able to soak up lots of attention.

He loves his comfy bed, snoozing and enjoying lots of love, hugs and cuddles. He has a goofy personality and loves his Food. He is a clever boy and likes to be kept mentally stimulated with his enrichment toys and puzzles.

Biscuit has not ever been around children, he could possibly live with Older Dog Savvy Teenagers with Sensible introductions.

Biscuit could live with a Confident Dog Savvy Cat with initial separation and slow introductions. He currently lives with a cat who he is good with however will try to chase cats while on walks.

Biscuit could possibly live with another dog with initial separation and very slow introductions. Biscuit currently lives with two dogs who he gets on very well with however was initially very reactive to the dog who arrived after him. Biscuit is also very reactive to dogs while on walks.

Biscuit accepts a collar, harness and lead. He wears his harness and muzzle on walks for more control and is always kept double leaded. Biscuit is a very strong boy and will need an active home in a quieter area to keep up with his energy levels.

He can be very overstimulated around other dogs which can cause him to be reactive. Biscuit enjoys his trips to secure fields to burn off all his energy and run around having fun.

Biscuit is toilet trained but is not crate trained. He has never been destructive and can be left alone for up to 5 hours with no issues. He sleeps very well overnight and will only bark rarely if he needs the toilet. He travels very well in the car and gets very excited for his adventures.

Biscuit can be a very good escape artist his home will need to have a secure garden to keep him safe. Biscuit has not displayed any guarding behaviours around his food previously however his family feel this could occur if he isn’t comfortable. He can guard high value treats or bones.

name: Lenny
description:
Lenny is a 4 year old medium male Cross-Breed.

Meet Lenny, This Handsome boy is looking for a new home to call his own. He can be a nervous boy so will need slow introductions and a quieter home. He loves his treats and will do anything for a snack such as peanut butter and bones!

Lenny can live with Older Dog Savvy Children 14+ following sensible introductions.

Lenny can share his home with another dog following sensible introductions. He loves playing with other dogs both on a walk and during his time at doggy day care and is more confident when around other dogs.

Lenny cannot live with cats due to his high prey drive.

Lenny accepts a collar, harness and lead and enjoys his long walks and exploring new areas, his recall is very good.

He can be nervous on walks around people which can cause him to bark however he will warm up with slow introductions especially if they have a doggy friend with them. An active home to continue his adventures would be ideal for him.

Lenny is fully toilet trained and he sleeps well over night in his crate and can be left for long periods of time with no issues.

Lenny can be Fearful of new people especially in his space which can cause him to be reactive towards visitors in the home but with slow and sensible introductions he can accept them.

name: Jake
description:
Jake approximately 3 years old medium sized male Cross-Breed.

Jake is one of our longer-staying residents here in Cheshire.

He’s only 3 years old and due to the pandemic didn’t experience much of the world around him and therefore can get easily overwhelmed causing him to react to strangers and surroundings, due to this Jake has been muzzle trained.

Staff and volunteers have been helping him with new experiences and understand that ‘normal’ activity isn’t scary – his training is going really well and he has made a lot of progress.

Jake loves playing with other dogs and with his toys and loves a fuss and cuddles once he gets to know you. Jake also loves his walks and sniffing around in the grass, stopping for treats along the way.

Jake is now ready for his forever home, he will need the right person who will continue with his training, give him the time he needs to settle – with a little time and patience, Jake will blossom but he needs to be given a chance.

name: Sonny
description:
Sonny is a 2-year-old large male cross-breed and is looking for his new home.

Although Sonny may resemble a rottweiler and is obviously a rotti cross, he shows traits of other active breeds. Sonny does have specific needs so please read Sonny’s full description before applying.

Sonny must live with another dog that is medium to large in size and that is of a balanced nature.

Sonny can be a bully towards older dogs so we wouldn’t home him to where there is an older dog. This behaviour doesn’t initially show.

Sonny can live in an adult-only home or where there are teenagers as well.

Sonny will require multiple visits from potential new owners so he can build a bond with you and your dog. Sonny will need to feel comfortable around you before adoption takes place.

Sonny prefers ladies over men but will accept men eventually. We aren’t sure of Sonny’s past up to approximately 6-8 months of age. He was found in a country lane amongst fly-tipped rubbish and was extremely scared and frightened of everything. It has taken him a long time to settle and accept people but once he does he is a very daft, loving and lively boy!

He can be very enthusiastic at times – sometimes this can be too much but he will eventually calm. A home where someone is around all the time is a must for Sonny. He will need as long as it takes to transition into his new surroundings and routine.

He is a very happy dog in familiar surroundings and company. Once he is bonded with you this is a great step in having him feel comfortable elsewhere hence why he will be on multiple visits. We know he will settle into a new home – he just needs experience and patience.

A home within one hour’s drive from Upminster RM14 so a home visit can be carried out.

name: Mason
description:
Mason is a medium sized crossbreed, he looks like he could be Labrador amongst other things. He is believed to be around seven to eight years old. Mason fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Mason has joined us recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania where he and his father and siblings spent some years. Harvey and Mason are the last of the family to come to us here.

Mason has taken to domestic life far quicker than we expected. We are already being treated to tail wags and he’s approaching for fuss.

In the weeks ahead he will continue to grow in confidence but is already enjoying his new world away from his cell in the shelter. He would like another dog for company in his forever home and could live with respectful aged twelve plus.

name: Ducessa
description:
Ducessa is a medium to large shepherd cross-breed around 4 years old (Born in 2022).

Our beautiful ‘Duchess’, born 2022 and 24kg, is affectionate, sensitive and bonds very strongly with her people. If you enjoy the rewards of training a dog (especially Shepherd types) but are looking for a slightly smaller dog, Ducessa may be your girl.

Ducessa is partially sighted – she can see well enough but her fosterer thinks she has tunnel vision.

We are looking for a reasonably experienced home for Ducessa; ideally one with Shepherd or larger breed experience.

The right home will find the prospect of investing time into training part of her appeal. Ducessa is a work in progress but, as her foster carer says, after a few months she will be a cracking dog!

Ducessa is already brilliant in the house; she loves to curl up on the sofa with you, will even try to share your chair! She walks ‘like a dream’ on the lead; (‘one of the best dogs I’ve ever had on the lead’ says a very experienced fosterer!)

Ducessa prefers being close to her person than bounding around, and is easy to manage. She travels well, is crate trained and sleeps through the night, enjoying a lazy morning.

She’s not a greedy girl; prefers her walk before eating her breakfast. Although she does like her treats…this makes her easy to train.

Ducessa is still a nervous dog in many respects. Outside, on walks and in the garden, she barks. She barks at dogs, unusual noises, traffic and people she does not know.

Her body language shows fear and frustration – she isn’t wishing to be aggressive, but is unsure, needs reassurance, input from her owner.

Her tail never stops wagging; she does want to be involved; wants to play. Her new home will understand these behaviours and how to work with Ducessa to improve her confidence.

Ducessa needs slow introductions to dogs and people.

Strangers coming to the home will unsettle Ducessa initially, this is an area of training that is being addressed, but again, we will need someone with the patience and experience to help her gain confidence.

Prospective adopters would need to meet her several times before taking her home.

Introductions to any other dogs in the house would need to be done slowly, and adopters must have the ability to separate her whilst she gets used to new surroundings and other dogs in the house. Ducessa has now settled with the other 3 dogs in her foster home.

It is thought Ducessa is good with cats but has not been cat tested in the UK

Originally rescued from the streets of Romania, Ducessa is very submissive to people she knows (happy to have food removed, feet wiped etc), but lacks confidence in the world.

She is looking for someone or people who will enjoy giving her the right care in order for her to blossom.

Please note – we do not rehome dogs to families with children under the age of 10.

Adult home with some experience of rescue dogs, willing to put the time into making Ducessa feel safe and confident. A home which wants to carry on and enjoys training. Shepherd or larger breed experience would be useful.

Ducessa can live with another dog, but this dog must be calm, patient and kind, and dog savvy, and introductions must be done slowly with the separation options mentioned above.

We are told Ducessa previously was fine with cats (in Romania)

Ducessa needs a quietish household; not busy. Probably somewhere rural or semi rural. Ducessa’s adopters will be willing to travel to meet her several times in her foster home in Norfolk to meet her before collecting her.

Ducessa would love a home with a garden. She is looking for a home where people are around most of the time, as loves to be with people.

Please read about our Adoption process. We really appreciate it when potential adopters have read our advice, and these are the people who are most often successful at application stage! https://www.bdruk.org/rehome

Our adoption donation is £325. This includes travel to the UK, their vaccinations, pet passport, microchip and all preparation for travel. They also come with 5 weeks free insurance.

name: Bonnie
description:
Meet Beautiful Bonnie: Your Future Professional Snooze Supervisor!

Bonnie joined us as an unclaimed stray from the pound, she was in a horrific condition full of lumps and a mouth full of rotten teeth, she also suffers from dry eye.

She has been bred from a lot and had an umbilical hernia that was fixed when she was speyed. It seems a classic case of, she has made them all the money but now she is worthless to them so she was thrown out like rubbish.

Bonnies Microchip says she is 12 years old but we all find this so hard to believe, we would have put her around 6 years old if it wasn’t for the microchip. It just makes it even sadder nobody cared for her in her advancing years.

Hello there! I’m Bonnie, a mature English Bulldog looking for a cosy retirement spot.

If you are looking for a gentle, easy-going companion to bring instant warmth and character into your home, I am ready to fill that position!

At 12 years old, I have officially mastered the art of peaceful living. I’ve left all the puppy chaos far behind and am completely dedicated to the finer things in life: comfortable naps, gentle head scratches, and being your most loyal shadow.

The Companion Life: I give the gentlest affection and will happily sit right at your feet keeping you company while you read, work, or watch TV.

Life in the Slow Lane: My energy level is highly efficient! A very short, leisurely stroll to sniff the grass is plenty of exercise for me.

The rest of my day is strictly reserved for lounging.

Classic Bulldog Charm: I come with the full package of adorable bulldog wrinkles, a wiggly tail when I see you, and a soundtrack of soft, happy grunts and content snores that are guaranteed to make you smile every day.

Low-Maintenance Roommate: I am incredibly well-mannered, perfectly house-trained, and past the stage of chewing things or bouncing off the walls. I just want comfort, routine, and a family to love.

Because I am a dignified senior lady, I am looking for a peaceful, retirement-style home where I can truly be pampered as the queen of the couch.

My older joints aren’t as bouncy as they used to be, so a home with minimal or no major stairs (or a family willing to give me a little lift) would be absolutely perfect for me.

I would thrive best in a calm environment where I can soak up all the love, gentle attention, and cosy spot options I deserve.

I have so much gentle affection left to give, and I can’t wait to find my match. Could your home be my perfect retirement haven? Please get in touch to learn more about making me a part of your family!

Bonnie does have a condition called dry eye, so she will need regular drops to keep them lubricated, other than that, she is an absolute doll with the sweetest expression, surely someone out there has a space for this gorgeous old girl.

name: Mojo
description:
