Mojo is an absolutely gorgeous little terrier mix that is approx. 8 years old. He was an unclaimed stray but we think he is a yorkie mix, he is only a dinky little fella, approx 4kg, and he was not microchipped.

On arrival we had him castrated, microchipped and he had a dental with quite a few teeth removed.

He has a lovely character that will melt you and he would make a fantastic companion for someone who likes the slower pace of life and a little buddy to talk to.

Mojo is a happy little guy that would love a family or person of his own, he absolutely loves food and snuggles – in no particular order!

Mojo is an inquisitive little guy, he likes to follow you around and has to know what’s going on, he is also a very laid back little lad perfect for an older person looking for a companion.

When Mojo first arrived he was pretty shell shocked, but as he has settled in his personality is shining through, he loves to run around with the other dogs in a secure field and he loves to sniff everything.

He has fab recall and walks lovely on a lead, he travels well and is an all round little pleasure to have.

He absolutely adores other dogs – especially the ladies, so could happily live with other dogs, that said he is also a very independent little man so would be happy as the only dog in the home as well.

Mojo is fine to be left for short periods and is a quiet little lad, not a barker like most smaller breeds. He will happily cuddle up in his bed, He is house trained however will scent mark in a new environment.

Mojo is a gorgeous happy little man that so desperately needs a forever home and family to grow up with. Mojo is neutered and recently had a dental, he is microchipped de flead and wormed.

name: Eto
description:
Eto is a two year old male Brittany. Eto is such a friendly, handsome young boy! Eto is a cheerful and lively dog, very energetic and active.

Eto is very affectionate and attached to people, loves cuddles and caresses, and obeys when called. He loves his food which will help with training.

Eto loves to run at full speed in the enclosure with his kennel mate Diana, with whom he has bonded from the first moment. He would love a doggy companion in his new home.

If you are interested in giving wonderful Eto a home, he is available at Setter Brittany Pointer Rescue.

Eto is in Spain and ready to travel to his forever home in the UK.

name: Freya
description:
Freya is a 4 and a half year female Mastin cross located in Spain.

Pretty Freya is a big, beautiful girl, with a smooth, soft, black and white coat, Her facial markings are unique and just enhances her beauty.

Freya is a Mastin cross, she stands at medium size. She came to the rescue with her sister Eida who has since been adopted but poor Freya is still in the rescue waiting for her new family.

Initially she was very timid and scared of people, but she has much more confidence now and enjoys attention and fuss from the volunteers.

Freya is great with people and children, and very laid back and gentle, she is also a very sweet, pretty girl, just so friendly and loves a cuddle.

She is not a dominant female and therefore gets along with all dogs, during her time at the rescue she has shared with male and female dogs. She currently shares with Luke and they make a good pair together as he is more dominant. She is not cat tested.

She is at the perfect age to adapt into a new home and with some initial time to settle she will make a loyal, loving family pet.

She can live with other dogs and older children and Freya walks very well on her lead. The rescue where Freya is living is closing and so she is one of 35 dogs looking for a home quickly. Can you help Freya with a loving forever home?

Great with people and dogs. gentle nature, and is obedient, and a pretty girl.

name: Sky
description:
Sky is a four year old female English Setter. Beauiful Sky is currently in foster in Essex. Sky is a shy girl and needs a kind and patient home to help improve her confidence and bring her out of her shell.

Sky is currently living with other resident dogs and getting on well with them, although she can be nervous at first. Sky is nervous of people and will benefit from a friendly resident dog in a home long term to help show her the ropes.

She picks her own safe spaces in the home and is gradually learning to trustBACKGROUND

Sky was given to the shelter we work with in North Spain by her hunter who could no longer look after her. The poor girl arrived very nervous with a lot of insecurities, Being in a home will help her overcome her worries.

If you are interested in giving wonderful Sky a home, she is available at Setter Brittany Pointer Rescue. Sky is currently in foster in Essex.

Can you offer Sky her forever home? Will that be with you?

name: Mac
description:
Mac, 3 years old, male, large cross breed.

Mac is a friendly boy who has waited a while in the shelter in Romania for the chance to travel to a new start in the Uk.

He is used to living with other dogs but has not been cat tested.

Mac would suit a family with older children, a couple or an individual who wants a soulmate of the dog kind!

He is gentle but due to his size her would probably be not suitable to live with young children.

He even has his own passport which holds all his medical records and procedures.

Mac has been fully vaccinated, including rabies and has had all the blood tests needed to comply with DEFRA regulations.

We deliver directly to the new adopter once checks have been done and we provide life long rescue back up.

name: Nero
description:
Nero is a 9-month-old male Cross-Breed. He is a large-sized dog with a playful and affectionate personality. His temperament is described as friendly and sociable, making him a great companion for a variety of households.

He is very cuddly and enjoys spending time with people. Nero is also good with other dogs and interacts well with them in social settings. His friendly nature extends to children, which means he could thrive in a family home.

However, Nero is not suitable to live with cats. This is an important factor for potential adopters to consider when thinking about their current household setup. Aside from this limitation, he appears adaptable and easy-going in most environments.

He will be rehomed with a full adoption package. This includes vaccinations, microchipping, blood testing, and neutering. These provisions ensure that he is well-prepared for his new home.

A full RBU is also included as part of the adoption process. A home check will be required to confirm that his new environment is suitable. These steps are important to ensure Nero’s long-term wellbeing.

Overall, Nero is a loving and energetic young dog with a friendly and gentle nature. He would suit an active household that can provide him with attention and companionship.

With the right home, he has the potential to become a loyal and devoted family member.

name: Zuri
description:
Zuri is a 9-month-old female Cross-Breed. She is described as a large-sized dog with a playful and affectionate nature. Her personality is friendly and sociable, making her a warm companion for people and families alike.

She is very cuddly and enjoys interaction, showing a gentle and loving temperament. Zuri gets along well with other dogs and thrives in their company. Her friendly behaviour also extends to children, making her suitable for a family environment.

However, she is not suitable to live with cats. This is an important consideration for households that already have feline companions. Aside from this, she appears adaptable and comfortable in social settings involving both humans and dogs.

Zuri is currently based in Cyprus but is able to travel to the UK or elsewhere in Europe. This makes her accessible to a wider range of adopters willing to arrange her relocation. Her transition would be supported with proper procedures already in place.

She will come with a full adoption package to ensure her health and wellbeing. This includes vaccinations, microchipping, blood testing, and neutering. These measures help provide reassurance that she is ready for a safe and healthy start in her new home.

A full RBU is also included as part of her adoption process. Additionally, a home check will be required to ensure that her new environment is suitable. These steps are in place to prioritise her long-term welfare and successful placement.

Overall, Zuri presents as a loving, energetic, and social dog who would do well in an active household. Her friendly disposition and compatibility with children and other dogs make her a strong candidate for many ???? types.

With the right home, she has the potential to become a loyal and affectionate companion.

name: Archie
description:
Archie is a lovely little tan and white male mixed breed who is currently in Oman. He is estimated to be born in December 2022 and was rescued off the streets of Oman as a young puppy.

He was taken in by a local rescuer where he stayed for approximately two years. Here he lived with many other dogs (large and small breed) and cats who he got along well with.

During this time, Archie suffered from skin mites which has sadly left him scarred.

Archie’s story is quite a sad one. Last year (2025), he had a home lined up in Germany but he sadly run off from his foster home and although we had search parties out day and night, we were unable to find him until 6 months later!

We aren’t sure how he managed to survive on the streets for all that time, we suspect someone may have taken him in, but when we were contacted about him, we immediately went to get him and brought him to the boarding facility where our other dogs reside.

Unfortunately, the adopters in Germany adopted another dog when they thought Archie was lost forever so he lost out on his forever home there.

Archie is a really lovely little dog. He is friendly especially once he knows you and loves playing with the other dogs in boarding. We think he would love a home with at least one other dog for company.

He could live alongside cats too. He could live with dog savvy/ respectful children.

We would love nothing more than to see him safe and loved in his forever home. We haven’t had any luck in finding this home in Oman so we are hoping his forever home is in the UK.

He is healthy, fully vaccinated, neutered and rabies titer tested so is ready to travel to the UK now. He will be tested for Brucella Canis before he leaves Oman.

name: Nellie
description:
Nellie is fostered in Spalding, Lincolnshire

Nellie was found abandoned as a 3 month old puppy in a small village in Romania, she was lucky and taken to a shelter until she was old enough to travel to the Uk.

Nellie is a bright, lively and inquisitive pup, she mixes well with other dogs but could also live as an only dog in a house where here person was at home most of the day.

Nellie is a little nervous when meeting new people but after receiving a couple of treats she is your friend for life.

Nellie would be happy living in a family environment with children 8 plus but she would be just as happy living with a couple or someone on their own, she would enjoy the attention.

Nellie is in foster home with other dogs so she is very familiar with living in a home and all the day to day activities that go on in a busy household, she is good on a lead, clean in the house and ok with being left for a few hours if she has the company of other dogs.

name: Lara
description:
Lara, this 5 year old female springer spaniel is the definition of a happy, active dog. She is the ultimate retriever — if you can throw it, she will chase it!

Balls, sticks, stones… even the occasional orange — she proudly collects her treasures and brings them back with pure excitement. She would thrive with an active person who enjoys walks, playtime, and a dog who’s always ready for the next adventure.

Despite her energy, Lara has an incredibly gentle soul. She is kind and calm with other animals and has a naturally sweet temperament that makes her easy to love.

Her past, however, was far from kind. Lara was found caged, severely underweight, and very unwell. But like many truly special dogs, she chose joy over fear. Today, she is full of life, energy, and affection — a true testament to her resilience.

Lara is also a Leishmania carrier, currently stable and well-managed with daily medication (Alopron 200, twice a day), which she takes without any fuss. She is regularly monitored and living a happy, healthy life.

She walks beautifully both on and off the lead, making her an easy and enjoyable companion outdoors.

While she gets along well with other animals, we believe Lara would truly flourish as the only dog in a home where she can receive all the love, attention, and activity she has been missing for so long.

Lara doesn’t just want a home — she’s ready to embrace life with someone who will truly be hers.

If you’re looking for a loyal, joyful, and energetic companion, Lara is waiting for you.

name: Reggie (Reginald)
description:
Reggie is a 5-year-old, neutered, microchipped and fully vaccinated spaniel boy who is ready to find his forever home.

This handsome guy is all heart. He absolutely lives for affection — hugs, attention, and being close to his person are what make him happiest. If you’re looking for a dog that will bond deeply and be by your side, Reggie is your dog.

He enjoys exploring and has excellent recall, happily roaming and always coming back to check in. He would thrive with an active owner who enjoys walks, outdoor time, and having a loyal companion along for the journey.

Reggie also has a natural protective instinct. He takes pride in watching over his home, often choosing to spend part of the evening outside keeping an eye on things before settling in for the night.

He’s the perfect mix of loving companion and gentle guardian.

While he gets along with other dogs and cats, we truly believe Reggie would flourish as the only pet in the home, where he can receive all the love and attention he craves.

Reggie is a healthy Leishmania carrier and is responsibly managed with daily medication (Alopron 200, twice a day), which he takes easily. He has been treated, is stable, and is regularly monitored.

His past wasn’t kind — he was found chained and already infected — but despite everything, he remains loving, trusting, and full of life. Now all he needs is someone to give him the safe, happy future he deserves.

Reggie isn’t just looking for a home — he’s looking for his person.

If you think you could be that person, he’s ready to meet you.

name: Kiri
description:
Kiri a is 2 year old male pointer mix. He was found by a friend of one of our volunteers who has cared for him in foster. It is now time to find him a loving forever home.

Kiri weights approximately 15kg he is medium size. He is neutered and fully vaccinated.

Kiri needs a fully secured private garden where he can run and play. He gets very excited when he meets you and does tend to jump up because he craves human attention.

It is something that can easily be overcome using positive reinforcement training techniques. Kiri is well socialised and gets along really well with other dogs.

Kiri is a typical pointer full of energy. His ideal home would be with an active family with a large secure garden.

He could be homed with another dog but would equally happy as an only dog with adopters who can commit to giving him time and patience and the exercise he needs.

Kiri will return this commitment with both unwavering love and loyalty.

name: Taco
description:
Taco is a one year old male mixed breed. Taco is a gorgeous young dog. He was handed to the shelter we work closely with because he is one of the many excess dogs no longer wanted in Spain.

When he arrived, he was quite scared, but with the companionship of the other dogs he quickly improved and overcame his fears.

Taco is very affectionate with people and charming. He loves being in the enclosure running and playing with his companion. He shares a kennel with a female dog, he loves to play with her and other dogs

If you are interested in giving wonderful Taco a home, he is available at Setter Brittany Pointer Rescue. Taco is in Spain and ready to travel to his forever home in the UK.

name: Zeus
description:
Meet our dear Zeus – a truly wonderful boy looking for his forever home.

Originally rescued from Croatia, Zeus is now ready to start his next chapter with an active, loving family.

If you enjoy the great outdoors, Zeus will be your perfect walking companion. He absolutely thrives in nature and walks beautifully alongside a pack of dogs. Exploring woodland trails, countryside paths, or long weekend adventures would be his dream come true.

Zeus is happiest when he’s out and about, taking in the sights and smells of the world around him. With his warm presence and love for adventure, he’ll make a loyal and devoted companion for someone who enjoys an active lifestyle.

Zeus loves his people and wants to be close to them most of the time

He forms strong bonds and enjoys being part of the family. When he’s not out exploring, he’s more than happy to snuggle up on the sofa and enjoy some well-earned cuddle time.

Zeus is a rescue dog who already has great potential. With his love of the outdoors, beautiful pack walking skills, and affectionate nature, he’s just waiting for the right home to truly shine.

Let’s get our gorgeous boy into a loving home.

He made such a long journey and now he’s stuck in kennels through no fault of his own

Could you be the one to give Zeus the forever home he deserves?

name: Cindy
description:
Cindy, our 1 year old disabled female mixed breed was allowed to roam freely as a puppy by her family in Cyprus — until one tragic day in October last year, she was hit by a car.

When they learned she would need an expensive surgery to survive, her family walked away, leaving her behind. They said they no longer wanted her… and left her in pain.

Fast forward to now: Cindy, we know, will remain paralysed in her back legs, she has been receiving regular laser treatment which has massively helped her, and she loves life with her foster mum and all the other dogs.

But it’s time for little Cindy to belong and have her own forever family, she is still a baby, 15 months old and just 6 kilos.

We will cover her flight costs if she is adopted in the UK. We are not looking for a foster home as she already is in a wonderful foster home. We are looking for an extra special forever family.

Despite her disability Cindy is full of life, happy and playful girl.

She can take some time to warm up to people who she hasn’t met before, the same with other dogs. But once she knows she is safe, she is very sweet and loves attention.

She gets around the house just fine without her wheels, she can also get into dog beds with no issues, steps are still a work in progress, and she will sit and cry if she gets “stuck” and unable to come back up them.

Cindy loves time in her wheels in open spaces where she can run and explore, she is amazingly quick in them, even out of them she’s quick too.

Cindy is understandably afraid of cars, we have been working on building her confidence with them, and she has since walked (in her wheels) down a side walk with a few cars passing, but if something bigger or louder was to pass she will freeze and then not want to walk any more.

She can poop and pee by herself, but it’s best to check if her bladder is empty 2-3 times a day just to prevent the chances of a urinary infection.

Cindy is currently on a RAW diet, as this keeps her poo firm (easy to clean up) and keeps her regular. Her two favourite times of day are breakfast and dinner, she is a little foody!

Are you the person we are looking for, that special person who can look beyond Cindy’s disability and who can see that in every other way Cindy is just an adorable pooch looking for a chance to live her best life.

name: Wilson
description:
Wilson is a 2 year old male Hound Cross. He was rescued in Cyprus as a baby of six months and flew to his current home in Mold, Wales at around a year old. He weighs around 27 kg.

Wilson is a deeply affectionate dog who forms strong bonds once he feels safe. When he trusts you, he is a total sofa snuggler and would happily spend the day curled up beside you, soaking up all the love.

Indoors, he is calm, settled, and content to relax, making him a lovely presence in the home.

Outside, Wilson has a playful side and enjoys stretching his legs in open spaces. He absolutely loves chasing his frisbee, although returning it is not really his strong point. He is more about the joy of the chase than the fetch itself.

Wilson walks beautifully on the lead when it is quiet. He can become excited and reactive when he sees other dogs, particularly at the start of a walk, but with calm handling and distraction he does settle.

Off lead, he enjoys playing with other dogs, although he can get a bit over-excited and benefits from gentle time-outs to help him calm himself.

He is excellent around food, with no begging, stealing, or guarding, and is fully house trained, crate trained, and sleeps soundly through the night. He can be left for a few hours without distress and does not suffer from separation anxiety.

Wilson is brilliant with familiar people and has been lovely with the children in his current home. However, he is a sensitive and easily spooked boy.

For this reason, he would be best suited to a quieter, adult-only home with minimal unexpected noise or activity, where he can truly relax and feel secure.

Wilson is being rehomed through no fault of his own. Sadly, despite time and patience, he has not been able to feel safe around one member of his current household and is living in a constant state of anxiety.

His family love him dearly and want him to have the calm, peaceful life he deserves.

Wilson would thrive in a calm, adult-only home with experienced or understanding adopters, a quiet environment with predictable routines, and someone willing to let him build trust at his own pace.

In the right home, Wilson will be an incredibly loyal and loving companion who gives his whole heart to his person. If you are looking for a gentle soul to share quiet days, cosy evenings, and meaningful bonds, Wilson could be your perfect match.

If you think you could be Wilson’s person, please get in touch.

Where in the country you liveYour experience with dogsA brief description of your garden and height of fencing at its lowest pointDetails of other dog or dogs in your homeAny other petsAges of any children in your home or who may visitTime a dog might be left alone each day and how they will fit into your lifestyleYour best contact number

He has been vaccinated, neutered, and microchipped.

A minimum adoption donation of £300 applies.

Adoption is subject to a satisfactory application and home check.

Post-adoption support is available from the rescue.

The rescue must be informed at any time of a change in circumstances. Wilson must never be handed over to any UK rescue or sold or adopted on without their knowledge. They will always endeavour to rehome their dogs when necessary.

name: Lily
description:
Lily is a 2 year old female Labrador Retriever Cross. She is a beautiful young mixed-breed girl with a look that hints at Labrador heritage and a personality full of life and love.

Rescued from Cyprus, she is now based near Peacehaven and ready to find her perfect forever home.

At nearly two years old, Lily is in her prime—full of energy, curiosity, and affection. She weighs around 22 kg and stands approximately 60 cm at the shoulder.

She thrives on playtime, especially chasing a ball or enjoying a good tug toy session, and she is just as happy settling down afterward for a well-earned rest.

Lily is house-trained, clean, and sleeps soundly through the night in her crate for up to nine hours. She sees her crate as her safe space and settles well after walks, though she does enjoy having people around when she is awake.

She communicates clearly too—expect a loud bark when she needs to go outside.

Out on walks, Lily is generally good on the lead, though she can get excited and pull if something catches her eye—especially squirrels or rabbits, as she has a strong prey drive.

Her recall is improving well, and she responds reliably to a whistle when using a long line.

She is friendly and sociable with other dogs when out and about, often engaging in playful, appropriate interactions, particularly with younger, energetic dogs.

However, due to her high energy and enthusiasm, she would be best suited as the only dog in the home or with a similarly playful companion. She would not be suitable for a home with cats or small animals.

Lily has not yet been fully assessed around children, as she is still quite bouncy and can jump up or mouth when excited. Therefore, any children in her new home should be older and confident around dogs. With continued training and guidance, she is making great progress and shows every sign of becoming a wonderfully well-rounded dog.

The only reason Lily is looking for a new home is due to a mismatch with the resident older dog, who cannot meet her playful needs. This has led to a few incidents driven by Lily’s excitement rather than aggression.

Lily is a truly sweet and affectionate girl who is learning quickly and eager to please. In the right home—one that can match her energy, continue her training, and give her the love and structure she needs—she will make an incredibly loyal and loving companion.

Please, when contacting, share the following:

Where you liveYour experience with dogsYour garden and fencing (height at lowest point)Other pets in the homeAges of children in the home or who visitHow long Lily may be left alone and how she will fit into your lifestyleYour best contact number

Lily is neutered, vaccinated, and microchipped. A minimum adoption donation of £300 applies. Adoption is subject to a satisfactory application and home check.

The rescue is committed to the lifelong care of their dogs and will always accept their return when space allows. In situations where space is limited, they will endeavour to rehome the dog directly from its current home.

Under no circumstances may the dog be transferred to another UK rescue organisation.

name: Bonnie
description:
Bonnie, also known as Bonbon, is an approximately 3 year old spayed female large mixed breed currently in foster care in Doncaster.

Bonnie is a gentle and sensitive dog who can be shy when meeting new people. She prefers a calm environment and takes time to build trust. Once bonded, she is affectionate and enjoys close companionship.

She is not aggressive but can be nervous around unfamiliar visitors. A quiet household with limited visitors will help her feel secure. She benefits from patient handling and consistent routine.

Bonnie thrives in the company of other dogs and must live with a calm, confident resident dog for reassurance and companionship.

She has previously lived with cats and may attempt to initiate play, so slow and managed introductions are required.

She is housetrained and crate trained. She sleeps overnight in her crate and can be left alone for short periods.

Bonnie walks well on a lead in quieter areas but remains cautious in busier environments. She is currently exercised on a long line due to a flight risk, and a secure garden is essential.

Continued confidence-building and structured training will be important.

Bonnie enjoys gentle play, grooming and relaxed time with her people. She responds well to food-based training.

Bonnie would suit a calm, rural or low-traffic home with patient adopters experienced in handling shy or sensitive dogs. Adults or older children who understand her need for space would be most appropriate.

name: Alan
description:
Alan is a 3 year old neutered male medium mixed breed currently in Lincolnshire. He is iElisa negative.

Alan is described as calm and people-focused. He enjoys staying close to his humans and settles well into routine. He is not highly energetic and prefers companionship and quiet time in the garden over long, demanding adventures.

He is fully housetrained and sleeps through the night. He has interacted well with men and children.

Alan generally respects other dogs’ space and is largely uninterested in them. However, he can show dominant behaviour towards younger or smaller dogs.

For this reason, he would be happiest as an only dog or in a home without young or boisterous dogs.

He has not yet begun formal lead training and will require patient introduction to walking equipment and structured guidance as this progresses.

Alan would suit a calm, steady household looking for a relaxed companion dog who enjoys close human company and routine.

name: Nova
description:
Nova – 2–3 year old female Whippet Cross (Medium/Large, slim build)ova is a 2–3 year old spayed female Whippet cross currently in foster care in Doncaster. She has a slim, athletic build and enjoys running and open space.

Nova is affectionate, intelligent and sensitive. She thrives on routine and bonds closely with her primary person, often choosing to stay nearby. She enjoys fuss and interaction but benefits from calm, predictable handling.

She is friendly with people and dogs. She may bark briefly when visitors first arrive but settles quickly with reassurance and positive guidance. She has not shown aggression.

Nova plays well with other dogs and would benefit from living with a calm or playful resident dog for companionship and confidence. If she feels unsure, she will give herself space rather than escalate.

She is housetrained, crate trained and understands basic commands.

She walks well on a lead and harness without pulling and is calm around other dogs when out. She travels well in the car and prefers quieter walking environments, as busy areas can make her nervous.

She is improving steadily with continued exposure and training.

Nova is an active dog who enjoys running and outdoor activity, but she also settles well in the home and sleeps soundly overnight.

Nova would suit a patient, structured home able to provide regular exercise, routine and ongoing confidence-building. A secure garden is important for safe exercise. An adult-only home or one with older children would be most appropriate.

name: Koi
description:
Koi is a medium English Setter who was originally bought by a hunter from a breeder but later abandoned to make space for another puppy.

The hunter even threatened to kill him if the rescue didn’t take him. Despite this harsh start, Koi remains cheerful, playful, and affectionate.

He is excellent with children, allowing them to pet him and enjoy the experience while staying calm and patient. Koi loves cuddles and human attention, and he is friendly with other dogs and people alike.

His medium-length coat is soft and well cared for, adding to his charm. Koi can live in a home with or without resident dogs and could also be cat tested for the right family.

He is a social, loving dog who will thrive in a home that offers affection and activity.

name: Oscar
description:
Our extra special boy Oscar is approximately five years old and is a delightful little cross breed.

Oscar weighs just five and a half kilos and measures ten inches from shoulder to paw.

Having been found abandoned on the streets Oscar has been in our Cyprus shelter for around three months.

Oscar is a super star. He has an enduring smile with a bubbly and playful personality.

With such a striking appearance and affable demeanour Oscar wins hearts and minds instantly.

His coat is quite exceptional with some solid black but predominantly black and grey brindle. With wide eyes and appealing glances Oscar is always the star of the show.

Oscar ticks all the boxes and will be very discerning with his choice of adopter. He just loves a cuddle and a hug ideally whilst on a lap.

Oscar walks nicely on his lead and thoroughly enjoys his time in the car. He seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Bertie
description:
Bertie is a gorgeous little Malshi that joined us when his owner struggled to look after him.

Bertie is a wonderful little lad, a bundle of fluff and love just waiting to devote himself to you!

He is absolutely stunning both inside and out and his cheeky little face look straight into your heart!!

He walks beautifully on the lead and is house trained, most of the day he spends snoozing on the sofa however he loves her food and walks! Bertie is a gentle little soul, he is a darling with not a bad bone in his body.

He is not destructive at all and is quite content being left for short periods. Bertie would love to live with other dogs a similar size to him.

I don’t think he enjoys being the only dog in the home however we would consider this if his carer is home alot of the time.

He is a very undemanding and lazy lad; he would suit an older person or couple. He absolutely loves to snuggle! Bertie is fine with other dogs and cats.

He loves to play with toys, especially squeaky ones, he goes mad for these. He also would chase a ball all day long!

This lovely lad would make a fantastic addition to any family as he is really laid back and undemanding, but equally a lovely cuddly loyal company.

Bertie would like an adult only home. When Bertie was younger he was stubborn and didn’t like being told what to do.

He has grown out of this and matured with age and we haven’t seen any bad behaviours from him what so ever however it is for this reason we want to find him an adult only home.

Bertie has a long coat that will need regular grooming, the adopters must be committed to this.

He can be a bit grumpy with his feet and face being groomed, so will need an experienced and understanding groomer who knows how to do this without causing him distress.

Bertie travels well but can get vocal when he is excited.

Bertie is castrated and chipped. he is flea and wormed. Could you give this beautiful lad the home he deserves?

name: Pip
description:
Pip is an absolutely gorgeous approx 6 year old miniature Dachshund , she weighs just 6 kg but that is 6kg of pure attitude, she is feisty and fearless and not afraid to show it!

She joined us from the pound as un unclaimed stray initially and has recently been returned by her adopter after 2 years due to a change of circumstances.

Pip is a little pocket rocket, she is absolutely fantastic and fearless, and although she is small, she doesn’t realise it, she will take on anything!

For that reason, we are looking for a home where she will be the only dog or at least a home where she can have her own space when needed.

She is quite jealous and prefers not to share her human with other dogs and she will push other dogs out to get top spot. She is absolutely fab to socialise with them outside of the home, but inside she likes her lap to herself.

She is absolutely fine to live with cats however and loves to curl up on the bed with them, and you!

Pip walks well on her lead, she has brilliant recall off lead in a secure field, however being a daxi, I think if she smelt prey she would be off! She is hilarious when she runs around like a little slinky!

Pip is a typical little lap dog inside, she loves nothing more than to snuggle with you. She will quite literally spend her entire day snuggled with you. She also likes to snuggle under the duvet with you at night.

She mixes fine with other dogs but is a very bossy little lady and likes to bark at the dogs when they are playing or acting up. She would be best as the only dog in the home as she isn’t keen on sharing her human!

Pip doesn’t like being left and will bark in protest, so she will need someone who is home most of the time or can take her with them on her travels!

She isn’t destructive unless food is involved, she has chewed a few treat barrels trying to get the food – little madam!

Pip can live with children age 8 years plus.

Pip is housetrained, but will do a protest poo if the weather is rubbish, however she will use pads in this situation.

Pip will need a breed experienced home, they may be small but are not a breed for the feint hearted! Pip suffers from alopecia which is common with this colour dogs, the hair is slowly growing back but it is very fine, not that it bothers her at all and she loves to show off her wardrobe!

Pip has been spayed, flea and wormed and treated for skin parasites.

Pip is a very sweet little dog that desperately wants a lap of her own to snuggle up on. Can you offer her this?

name: Inka
description:
Inka is a smallish whippet like crossbreed aged two to three years old. Inka fostered Dereham Norfolk.

Inka has joined us recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. She is a quiet and shy girl with the whippet sensitive nature.

She mixes well with the other dogs in her foster home but likes a quiet life and would not enjoy living with boisterous or bouncy dogs.

She would like a calm and quiet home environment where she can relax and enjoy peace. She would like an adult home but wouldn’t be a problem with children visiting.

name: Verity
description:
Verity is a smallish whippet like crossbreed aged two to three years old. Verity fostered Poringland Norfolk.

Verity has joined us recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. She is a quiet and shy girl with the whippet sensitive nature.

She mixes well with the other dogs in her foster home but likes a quiet life and would not enjoy living with boisterous or bouncy dogs.

She would like a calm and quiet home environment where she can relax and enjoy peace. She would like an adult home but wouldn’t be a problem with children visiting.

name: Cleo
description:
Cleo is a stunning 2 year old Cane Corso with a loyal and affectionate nature.

Cleo is a gentle and sensitive girl who forms strong bonds with her people. She is very people-focused and loves to be close, often sitting beside you or resting her head on you for comfort and reassurance.

In the home, Cleo is calm, clean, and well behaved. She is crate trained, settles beautifully, and shows no destructive behaviour. She enjoys her comforts, including relaxing with her family and playing with her favourite toys, especially her squeaky ball.

Cleo walks nicely on the lead and regularly checks in with her handler, showing a willingness to learn and stay connected. She mixes well with other dogs, particularly when introductions are handled correctly, and has shown she can live with a dog-savvy cat.

Cleo is a sensitive soul who can be wary of unfamiliar men or sudden movements. However, with calm and patient introductions, she builds trust well and relaxes into her environment.

She is currently receiving behavioural support and continues to make positive progress.

Due to her breed and temperament, Cleo requires a knowledgeable home with experience of guardian breeds. She thrives in a calm, structured environment with clear guidance and consistency.

Cleo would suit an adult-only home or one with older, dog-savvy teenagers who understand her needs and can give her the time and space to settle.

Cleo is a devoted and loyal companion who, in the right home, will become an incredibly rewarding and loving addition to the family.

name: Roxy
description:
Roxy is an 18 month old female Caucasian shepherd located in Spain

This beautiful, medium-sized Caucasian Shephard is Roxy, still young at 18 months, she has the traditional dark, tan semi coat and black masked face, who has recently been saved by us from the streets.

Roxy is a very sweet girl, still a youngster, she can be nervous around new dogs to begin with until she knows they are friendly, but generally once introduced correctly she’s very playful and good with the dogs, but she can be a bit of slow burner.

Roxy walks very well on her lead and we think that she is suitable for a family with older children with or without another friendly dog as she can be a bit excitable.

Roxy is a no to cats we think, it’s not that she’s aggressive, but she chases them.Roxy is ready to travel now for the right family.

Great with people and dogs. gentle nature, and is obedient, happy to play and a pretty girl.

name: Kalli
description:
Kalli is a young, athletic crossbreed aged just over 1 year old with a loving and energetic nature.

Kalli is very people-focused and forms strong bonds with her humans. She thrives on interaction and enjoys being close, often seeking reassurance and connection from those around her.

She is an intelligent and eager-to-please dog who is already showing great potential. Kalli knows basic commands such as sit and wait and is continuing to learn, responding well to training, especially when food rewards are involved.

Kalli is still very much a young dog and can become easily overstimulated, particularly around other dogs. She can struggle to regulate her excitement and may not always communicate appropriately, which can lead to misunderstandings. For this reason, she will need to be the only pet in the home while she continues to build confidence and develop her social skills.

She walks well on the lead in calmer environments but can become strong and determined if something catches her attention. With consistent, one-to-one training, she is continuing to improve.

Kalli can become bored if not mentally stimulated, so she will require enrichment and an active home that can meet both her physical and mental needs. She may also jump up when excited but is already learning that calm behaviour is rewarded.

Kalli would suit a home that is committed to training, structure, and consistency. She will thrive with owners who understand how to guide a young, energetic dog and are willing to invest time into her development.

Kalli is a loving and loyal dog with huge potential, and in the right home, she will grow into a deeply rewarding and devoted companion.

name: Rebecca
description:
Rebecca is a beautiful black Greyhound, thought to be around 5 years old (possibly a little older), currently fostered in North Lincolnshire.

She arrived from Ireland in search of her forever home here in the UK, after an incredibly sad past. Rebecca was rescued in a terrible condition and was clearly used for breeding.

Despite everything she has endured, she has the most gentle and loving nature.

Since settling into foster, Rebecca has adapted wonderfully to home life. She adores her cosy bed, enjoys her daily walks, and gets very excited at mealtimes.

After breakfast and a walk, she’s more than happy to spend the rest of the day snoozing peacefully.

Rebecca is a calm, gentle soul who is lovely around children and has been great with the dogs she has met. She walks beautifully on the lead, although she can show a little strength when squirrels grab her attention!

Rebecca has no ear markings, so her exact age cannot be confirmed, but she is ready now to find the loving home she truly deserves.

name: Elsa
description:
Elsa is a 1.4 year old spayed female mixed breed with Husky-type characteristics, currently in Oxfordshire. She is iElisa negative.

Elsa is an affectionate and energetic young dog with a curious and intelligent nature. She enjoys human company and likes to be involved in daily activities.

She has a playful and enthusiastic personality and benefits from regular physical and mental stimulation. Although lively, she settles well after exercise and enjoys resting alongside other dogs in the home.

She is continuing to build confidence and can show assertive behaviour during energetic play.

Elsa is friendly with adults and enjoys attention. Due to her size and excitable nature, she would be best suited to a home with older children.

She enjoys rough-and-tumble play with other dogs and would benefit from living with a confident, energetic dog who matches her play style. She does not show food guarding.

She is not suitable for homes with cats or small animals due to a strong chase instinct.

She may bark at unfamiliar visitors and can appear anxious initially, but settles with calm, positive introductions.

Elsa’s housetraining is still in progress and she will require continued consistency and supervision.

She is not crate trained and becomes distressed if confined in a crate, particularly in the car, although she travels well once settled.

She walks well on a harness and collar but is strong and energetic. She may become overexcited on grassed areas.

Her recall is good in secure enclosed spaces, and she is more confident walking alongside another dog than alone.

name: Dolly
description:
Dolly is a spayed female mixed breed currently in foster care in Staffordshire. She is iElisa negative.

Dolly was rescued together with several members of her family group in Romania. The dogs were found living together in a field and clearly formed a close family unit.

She has recently arrived in the UK and is still settling into her foster home. At the moment she can be a little unsure around people but is gradually building confidence and beginning to come out of her shell.

She is becoming more comfortable around the people in the household and accepts gentle interaction.

Dolly enjoys the company of other dogs and would benefit from living with a friendly resident dog who can help her continue to gain confidence.

Dolly enjoys relaxing on the sofa and spending time near her foster family once she feels safe. She also enjoys her food and settles well into the home routine.

She will sometimes join in barking when other dogs bark.

name: Roo
description:
Roo is a 1 year old spayed small mixed breed weighing around 10kg, currently in foster care in Staffordshire. She is iElisa negative.

Roo is a happy, energetic little dog with a gentle nature. She loves people and enjoys being around her humans.

She can initially be a little shy around loud noises but settles quickly with reassurance.

She is playful and lively and enjoys interaction with people and other dogs. Roo gets along well with dogs of all shapes and sizes.

Roo is housetrained with regular access to the garden and settles well in the home. She is not crate trained.

She accepts wearing a collar and lead and is beginning to get used to short walks around the garden area.

Continued lead training and confidence-building will help her become more comfortable walking outside the home.

Roo would suit an active household able to provide regular exercise, companionship and continued training as she matures.

name: Mylo
description:
Mylo is a 6 year old neutered small mixed breed currently in foster in Staffordshire. He weighs approximately 14kg and stands around 47cm tall. He has a distinctive stump tail and a confident little character.

Mylo previously spent a long period living as a stray before entering rescue. He has now settled well into foster care and is enjoying the comfort and routine of home life.

He is affectionate but independent and prefers interaction on his own terms. He enjoys gentle fuss, especially belly rubs, and likes spending time pottering around the house before settling down nearby.

Mylo is friendly with people but appreciates his personal space and will communicate when he has had enough attention. For this reason he would be best suited to an adult-only home.

He can interact well with other dogs he feels comfortable around but does not enjoy overly energetic behaviour, particularly from puppies. He may be happiest as the only dog, although he could potentially share with a calm and respectful companion. He can be protective of food around other dogs so feeding will need to be managed.

Mylo is housetrained and settles well in the home environment. He tolerates gentle handling but is sensitive about his tail being touched.

Mylo would suit a quiet household able to provide routine, companionship and respect for his boundaries. A secure garden would be beneficial for relaxed outdoor time as he enjoys pottering and lounging outside.

name: Bon Bon
description:
Bon Bon is a 1.5 year old spayed small to medium mixed breed currently in foster in Staffordshire. She is iElisa negative.

Bon Bon is a very sweet, shy-natured girl who is enjoying life in foster.

She is housetrained and sleeps through the night without issue.

Bon Bon gets along well with other dogs and could happily live with a canine companion or as the only dog in the home.

She can be a little shy at first and needs a family who will give her time and patience to build her confidence and bond with them.

Bon Bon accepts a collar and lead but will need further training to walk confidently outside the home. She has been walked in a field near her foster home and, although hesitant at first, soon enjoyed sniffing and exploring.

She enjoys time in the garden and then returning inside for snuggles on the sofa. At present she has a fairly low energy level and enjoys short play sessions followed by rest.

Bon Bon is currently more comfortable around women than men, although she shows no aggression and is simply shy.

Bon Bon would suit a quiet home with patient adopters who will allow her time to settle and continue building confidence.

name: Lupin
description:
Meet Lupin, a 4 month old male Griffon Cross who is expected to grow into a medium-sized dog of around 18–20 kg when fully grown.

Lupin is a charming young puppy born on 1 November 2025. He is one of six brothers born to a Griffon cross mum.

Lupin has spent his early months at the Residencia Garatuxa shelter in Galicia, where he has grown up surrounded by people, other dogs, and everyday shelter activity. This has helped him develop into a sociable and confident puppy.

He enjoys playing with his brothers and interacting with people, showing a friendly and open nature. Lupin will thrive in a home where he can continue learning, exploring, and becoming a much-loved family member.

He has been tested for Mediterranean diseases and will be fully prepared for travel, vaccinated, microchipped, and with his passport ready. Lupin will be ready to travel in April.

As with all of our dogs, he comes with full rescue back-up.

name: Hamish
description:
Meet Hamish, a 4 month old male Griffon Cross who is expected to grow into a medium-sized dog of around 18–20 kg when fully grown.

Hamish is one of six lively brothers born on 1 November 2025 to a Griffon cross mum. He is currently nearly four months old and, like his siblings, is expected to grow into a medium-sized dog.

Hamish has had a good start to life at the Residencia Garatuxa shelter in Galicia, northern Spain. Growing up in the shelter environment means he is already used to people, everyday activity, and different sounds around him.

He is a very sociable puppy who enjoys interacting with both humans and other dogs.

As a young puppy, Hamish will benefit from a family willing to continue his training and give him the guidance, exercise, and affection he needs as he grows.

He has been tested for Mediterranean diseases and will be fully prepared for travel, vaccinated, microchipped, and with his passport ready. Hamish will be ready to travel in April to the right home.

As with all of our dogs, he comes with full rescue back-up.

name: Rosie
description:
Rosie is a 1 year old female cross-breed with unique and lovely markings. DOB 10/7/2023.

Abandoned in woodland with her siblings at a tender age, she found refuge in a foster shelter, where she currently resides.

Rosie, a good-sized medium dog, walks well on a lead, great with other dogs & older children.

This resilient pup has undergone thorough veterinary care, including comprehensive blood tests, ensuring her seamless integration into life in the UK.

Ideal for an experienced family well-versed in dog ownership, Rosie is best suited for a household with children over 8 years old, given her size.

She comes fully vaccinated, microchipped, and equipped with a pet passport and medical papers detailing her health history.

The commitment to her well-being extends beyond adoption, with the assurance of lifetime rescue backup and ongoing support from the dedicated rescue centre.

For households with feline companions, a cat test can be conducted to assess Rosie’s compatibility.

The rescue centre emphasises their dedication to the welfare of their dogs, offering not just a new family member but a guarantee of continuous support for Rosie’s lifetime.

name: Miro
description:
Miro is a large, 3-year-old male Romanian Shepherd, born on 10th November 2020. He has been neutered, possesses a passport, and is up-to-date on vaccinations.

Currently located in kennels in the UK, Miro found a family in November but is now back, awaiting that special someone who can offer him a forever home.

Despite his heartbreaking return to kennels, Miro remains affectionate and is a superb cuddler. Desperate for love, he quickly forms strong bonds with those around him.

In search of an extraordinary home, Miro requires a quiet rural or semi-rural setting with a spacious and secure garden. Ideally, his new home should be an adult-only environment without other animals.

Potential adopters must have experience with large-breed Romanian Shepherds, and be willing to invest time in building a relationship with Miro, his trainer, and the team familiar with him.

Miro, being sensitive to his surroundings, needs someone patient, who can ensure he feels comfortable and safe.

While Miro can be overwhelmed by his environment, in the right home, he proves to be an exceptionally loyal companion. Engaging in scent training has not only showcased his natural ability but also helped reduce his anxiety.

It’s essential to note that Miro can be reactive on a lead and may struggle with reading other dogs. Despite his strength, he walks beautifully on a lead and is comfortable wearing a muzzle, a requirement for his safety.

Prospective adopters must commit to having him wear a muzzle at all times outside the house and a double lead.

name: Harley
description:
Harley is a 6-month-old male Cross-breed, born on 29th July 2021, with a large-sized stature standing at 64cm, chest measuring 78cm, and neck circumference at 46cm.

Rescued from an unfortunate situation, Harley, along with his eight siblings, was discovered abandoned and hungry at a chicken abattoir in Romania.

After their rescue, they found temporary refuge in a friend’s yard, where a large kennel run was set up for them until space became available at Happy’s, where Harley is currently residing.

Harley, a sweet and lively young dog, has adapted well to his new environment at Happy’s. Despite the tragic loss of one of his brothers, Casper, Harley is in good health.

Neutered and up-to-date with vaccinations, he is ready for adoption. His ideal family should be willing to dedicate time to care for him, provide support for his development, and engage in training activities.

Harley has proven to be friendly and sociable, getting along well with other dogs, cats, and goats. However, caution is advised around chickens as he does not interact positively with them.

For those considering adopting Harley and meeting his needs, the rehoming process involves filling out a registration form. The rehoming team at Happy’s will then be in touch to facilitate the adoption process.

name: Trixie
description:
Trixie is a small 5 month old female Jack Russell Cross puppy, born on 28th March 2026, who is expected to remain a small adult.

Trixie is currently cared for in our small, cage-free home rescue in Bulgaria and is available for adoption to families in the UK.

She was found abandoned with her two brothers on a building site in Bulgaria. Thankfully, those difficult days are now behind them, and all three puppies are safe, healthy and thriving while they wait for their forever homes.

Trixie is a happy, playful little girl with a wonderful zest for life. She loves exploring, playing with the other puppies and then curling up for cuddles when it’s time to relax.

She is friendly, affectionate and enjoys human company, making friends wherever she goes.

She is full of confidence without being overwhelming and has the bright, curious personality that makes every day an adventure.

Trixie is already showing all the qualities of a fantastic family companion and will thrive with continued training, socialisation and plenty of love as she grows.

Trixie enjoys the company of other dogs and would happily live with another friendly canine companion. Equally, she would be just as happy as the only dog in a home where she will receive lots of attention and be included in family life.

If you’re looking for a small puppy with a big personality, Trixie could be the perfect addition to your family.

At Rescue Dogs For Adoption, all of our dogs live as part of our family in a home environment rather than kennels, allowing us to understand their personalities and carefully match them with the right homes.

We consider all applicants because finding the perfect match is far more important than ticking boxes.

If you think Trixie could be the perfect addition to your family, we’d love to hear from you.

name: Johnny
description:
Johnny is a 1 year old male Cross-Breed, truly adorable little chap currently thriving in his UK foster home.

He’s neutered. At just 1 year old, lots of energy and has settled in beautifully. Johnny is a bright, cheerful soul with a wonderfully cheeky personality.

He’s making great progress with his toilet training and has just begun exploring the world on his walks. He’s good on both lead and harness, curious about everything he sees, and is gradually becoming more confident around traffic.

Johnny is living with an older female dog at the moment, but he would absolutely love a younger, playful companion to match his energy.

He cannot live with cats. He hasn’t met children yet, so we would say children aged 12+.

He is such a sweet, happy youngster who’s ready for his forever home.

name: Hershey
description:
Hershey is a 6-month-old male large-sized cross-breed dog with a height of 64cm, a chest measuring 78cm, and a neck circumference of 46cm.

He is located in Romania and has been neutered. Hershey, along with his 8 siblings, was discovered abandoned, hungry, and alone at a chicken abattoir.

Fortunately, they were taken into foster care in a friend’s yard, where a large kennel run was constructed for them until space became available at Happy’s, a rescue center.

This sweet and lively young dog has since settled well at Happy’s. Unfortunately, one of his brothers, Casper, didn’t survive, arriving too late for assistance.

Hershey is described as typical, and his new family is expected to invest time in caring for him, and providing support in terms of development and training.

Remarkably, Hershey shows compatibility with other dogs, cats, and goats, but caution is advised around chickens.

Hershey is fully vaccinated and possesses a passport. If you believe you can meet Hershey’s needs, the recommendation is to complete a registration form, and the rehoming team at Happy’s will be in touch.

name: Faye
description:
Meet Faye, a female approximately 4 years old medium/large sized Cross-Breed.

She’s nervous of new people but doesn’t take long to come around, just make sure you have plenty of treats around!

She’s a playful girl with high energy and loves nothing more than her walks.

Faye would make a very good walking companion.

Faye is very clever and very food orientated so she is easy to train.

Faye loves to play with other dogs and loves to be around people she trusts.

Faye would thrive better in a home without children as she can sometimes be unaware of her size when excited and due to her nervousness about people.

name: Arun
description:
Meet Arun. Male approximately 8-9 years old of small-medium size Cross-Breed.

Arun is looking for an adult only and pet free home.

He is a sweet, affectionate boy but it takes time for him to get to know you.

Arun space and food guards around new people so his new home must be aware of this and give him the space he needs around the home.

Arun walks lovely on the lead and enjoys group walks with the other dogs at our kennels however he would prefer to be the only dog in the home.

Arun needs an understanding home who will give him a chance. Do you have the heart to give Arun a chance at life outside of the kennels?

name: Brutus
description:
Brutus is a male Cross-Breed approximately 7 years old of medium/large size available for foster/adoption.

Nervous boy Brutus is looking for a foster or forever home to call his own.

Brutus is a very nervous boy, He hasn’t worn a lead or collar. He is nervous of noises so he will need a quiet home.

Brutus is a sweet boy and once he trusts you he enjoys a stroke behind his ears.

In the home, Brutus will need work to build up his confidence and eventually relise the world isn’t a scary place)

name: Bailey
description:
Bailey is approximately 4 years old. Medium sized male Cross-Breed.

Bailey is looking for an adult only home. He likes people and will jump to say hello when he first meets you.

He likes to fetch a toy and bring it to you as an invitation to play.

He can be nervous on walks and will lunge at passing traffic. This is something that will need further training.

Bailey is currently reactive towards cats and dogs, for this reason he would suit a home where he is the only pet to allow further training to be carried out on his reactivity.

He has met other dogs but must be supervised when he does.

Bailey is toilet trained and enjoys travelling in the car.

Bailey is not crate trained and has not been left alone at home.

name: Rolly
description:
Rolly, known as Neeko, is a 6–7 year old neutered male medium mixed breed currently in Lincolnshire.

Neeko is a gentle and affectionate boy who thrives on human company. He enjoys being close to his people and likes to be involved in daily life. Once he feels settled and secure, his loyal and loving nature becomes very apparent.

He is great with children and enjoys their company. Neeko is good with other dogs; however, he can feel overwhelmed in large groups. He would be happiest either as the only dog in the home or living with one or two calm, friendly companions.

Neeko is not suitable to live with cats, as he will chase and reacts strongly to them when out on walks.

He walks nicely on a lead when focused. If he becomes excited by other dogs or people, he responds well to guidance and can be asked to stop, sit and refocus before continuing calmly.

Neeko does not cope well with being crated and becomes stressed, so he will need a crate-free home. He settles well once he feels safe and part of a consistent routine.

Neeko would suit a loving and stable home looking for an affectionate companion. He enjoys an active lifestyle and would thrive with adopters who can offer reassurance, structure and plenty of companionship.

name: Seona and Luigi
description:
Seona is a small mixed-breed around 4 years old and Luigi is a small mixed-breed around 7 years old.

Seona and Luigi are fostered together in Staffordshire. Seona is spayed and Luigi is neutered. A reduced adoption donation applies if they are adopted together.

Their journey began with heartbreak when their elderly owner sadly passed away and they were left without care. Thankfully, a rescuer stepped in and they are now safe in foster — but they are looking for a loving forever home together.

These two are completely bonded and it would break their hearts to be separated. They truly are joined at the hip.

Both are gentle, affectionate, and well-mannered. They are housetrained, sleep soundly through the night, and greet each morning with wagging tails. They both love their food and treats.

They are comfortable walking on lead and would benefit from continued confidence-building in new walking environments. A secure garden is essential for their new home.

They are good with other dogs and play nicely with their chosen companions. They are also good with cats.

Seona is the more confident of the pair and often keeps a watchful eye over Luigi. Luigi is more submissive and sweet-natured, happily following Seona’s lead.

They adore sofa snuggles, watching television, and sitting on the windowsill observing the world.

Their foster believes they would thrive best in a quiet home with a secure garden, ideally as the only dogs where they can enjoy peace and attention together.

If you are ready for double the affection and companionship, Seona and Luigi are waiting to meet you.

name: Buddy
description:
Buddy is a 1-year-old male Jura Hound. He was born on 06/01/2025 and is currently in a shelter in the north of Spain waiting for a forever home.

He was surrendered because he was not suitable for hunting. Despite his rough start, he is still very young and capable of learning quickly.

Buddy is nervous around people but has already shown noticeable improvement since arriving at the shelter. With time and reassurance, he continues to build confidence.

He gets along well with other dogs. However, he is fed separately because he becomes anxious around food and is very enthusiastic at mealtimes.

Buddy is an active and playful dog who enjoys running around and exploring the garden. He loves using his nose and investigating scents in his surroundings.

He will need an active household willing to provide both exercise and guidance. A patient family prepared to teach him and spend quality time doing activities will suit him best.

As a scenthound with hunting training, his recall may be unreliable. Secure outdoor spaces and careful handling will therefore be important.

He would benefit from structure and routine to help him feel safe and settled. Given consistency and kindness, he should continue gaining confidence and become a loyal companion.

Full rescue back up is provided to support both Buddy and his adopters throughout the process.

name: Zar
description:
Zar is a 6-year-old male Sabueso Hound. He was born on 03/06/2019 and is currently waiting in the north of Spain for a permanent home.

He had to be urgently rescued because he was not suitable for hunting. Being in the hands of a hunter placed him in danger, so rescue intervention was necessary for his safety.

Zar is described as a very obedient dog. Despite this, he is extremely shy and clearly frightened by people due to whatever experiences he has previously endured.

He is sociable with other dogs and feels more comfortable around them. However, he still needs to learn that humans can be trusted and will not harm him.

Because he is a scenthound trained for hunting, his recall may be unreliable. His instincts are strong and secure handling will be important in everyday life.

Zar needs patience, love, and time to properly adjust to a family environment. What he truly requires is a home that will finally give him the dignity and kindness he has never known.

Full rescue back up will be provided to ensure both Zar and his adopters receive support. With understanding and consistency, he has the potential to become a devoted companion.

name: Hueso
description:
Hueso is an 8 year old male Sabueso Hound currently in foster care in Kent, UK.

Hueso is a quiet, nervous boy who needs a special person to give him time and patience to settle. He loves female humans and is more comfortable with them but he will get used to men over time.

He is not aggressive but he will avoid and try to make himself invisible.

Hueso would benefit from a kind dog to live with to help him, especially when humans need to go out, as Hueso does have separation anxiety. Ideally he needs someone who is home a lot or works from home.

He loves his walks. He is not scared of traffic or people on walks but he might sometimes bark at people. So someone who loves to go walking a couple of times a day would be great for this boy.

Hueso has luxating patella so he needs to be on supplements like YuMove and he does need some good walks at a good distance to keep him mobile plus to keep his weight at a good level.

Hueso is a scenthound and can pull on the lead after scents at times.

name: Noodle
description:
Noodle is a 1 year old male Cross-Breed. He is described as a lovely and energetic dog with a very friendly nature. Every person he has met so far has been greeted warmly and positively.

He gets along well with all other dogs he has encountered. His sociable personality makes him a pleasant companion in shared spaces. He clearly enjoys interaction and company rather than being solitary.

Noodle is comfortable wearing both his collar and harness. However, he has not yet learnt proper lead manners and can pull during walks. Continued training and guidance will be important for improving his walking behaviour.

Despite being excitable, he also enjoys affection and closeness. He happily settles down for cuddles and even thinks of himself as a lapdog. Quiet bonding time is just as important to him as active time.

His ideal home would include a good garden and plenty of opportunities for walks. Having other dogs around to play with would suit him well. After activity, he would love nothing more than relaxing on the sofa for a snuggle.

Noodle is currently in foster care in Southampton. He is looking for a home that matches both his energy and affectionate side. With structure and companionship, he should settle nicely into family life.

name: Olivia
description:
Olivia is a medium sized dog set on a small dogs legs. She is probably a corgi cross or similar. She was born in March 2025 – making her eighteen months old. Olivia fostered Norwich Norfolk.

“Olivia was found by the side of the road, she had been hit by a car. We actually went to that village searching for a mum with pups and Olivia was lying down, wagging her tail.

At the beggining she appeared just to be resting but then we noticed she did not get up. Probably she had just been hit. She had an open humerus fracture, the bone was completely broken in two.

Despite this she did not bite when we lifted her up into the car. She has a very sweet optimistic temperament.”

Olivia is now in the UK and is a little sweetheart. She has a pin in her previously damaged leg which will remain in for the rest of her life. She should require no further treatment but may get arthritis in later life…. as do we all lol.

Olivia is mixing very nicely with the other dogs in her foster home but could live very happily as the only dog in the home. She could live with respectful children aged four plus. She is a calm and gentle girl who loves people.

name: Jemma
description:
Jemma is a medium sized crossbreed aged a year old. Jemma fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Jemma has come into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. She is a sweet, affectionate and playful girl who will simply need a bit of basic training and new experiences.

She mixes well with the other dogs in her foster home but could also be the only dog in her forever home.

She could live with respectful children aged six plus.

name: Lulu
description:
Lulu is a medium sized crossbreed aged a year old. Lulu fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Lulu has come into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. She is a sweet, affectionate and playful girl who will simply need a bit of basic training and new experiences.

She mixes well with the other dogs in her foster home but could also be the only dog in her forever home. She could live with respectful children aged six plus.

name: Keira
description:
This beautiful, little, tan and black, puppy girl is Kiera. She is around 3.5 months old and is an adorable, friendly and affectionate, little mixed Pointer girl, who’s waiting to be adopted.

Kiera was raised in a loving home after her pregnant mum was found abandoned. She’s now in our care with 3 of her siblings, who are now homed.Her mum is a smaller pointer but no idea about dad so she’s expected to be a medium sized adult.

Kiera is Currently 10kg and has had her first 2 puppy vacs and passport so is ready for adoption.

We are looking for a family with or without other dogs and children over 10 years old

name: Frank
description:
Frank is a smallish crossbreed aged around eighteen months old. Frank fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Frank has come into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. He is a cute and friendly little guy who loves everybody he meets.

He’s great with other dogs but could also be the only dog in the home. He has been friendly with the safe rescue cat and loves children of all ages.

name: Dylan
description:
Dylan is a smallish crossbreed aged around eighteen months old. Dylan fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Dylan has come into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. He is a cute and friendly little guy who loves everybody he meets.

He’s great with other dogs but could also be the only dog in the home. He has been friendly with the safe rescue cat and loves children of all ages.

name: Zara
description:
Zara is a 3 year old female Cross-Breed who measures 40 cm and is on the smaller side of medium.

Zara was found abandoned in Romania as a tiny puppy and was taken to a private shelter where she has remained for the last three years.

She spends her life in a very cold kennel with two other dogs. The volunteers all work, so the dogs only get a visit twice a day where they are let out for a run, then back into their kennels again.

Zara is very lonely and would love a home. She is always so happy to see the volunteers. In the picture, you can see Zara’s pen after the snow had melted.

It lacks a full roof as the rescue cannot afford good kennels for all the dogs. They have around 160 dogs and only 40 of them have proper kennels.

Zara is spayed and vaccinated, and she will be tested for Brucellosis. The test is now sent to the UK prior to travel and, if negative, a dog must travel within 30 days of the test.

She will also receive further blood tests in Romania, will be microchipped, and will have a passport.

If you can offer this absolutely lovely girl a forever home, please get in touch. She will make the most wonderful companion and light up your life. A home check is required and her adoption fee is £550. She will be transported to your home.

name: Asha
description:
Asha is a medium sized crossbreed aged around eight years old. Asha fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Asha has arrived into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. She is a sweet, calm and friendly girl who is friendly with everyone.

She mixes great with the other dogs in her foster home but could also live very happily as the only dog in the home. She could live with respectful children aged eight plus.

name: Ula
description:
Ula is one of 33 Brittanys who were kept together on a piece of land and used for hunting and showing.

When the land was put up for sale and the dogs needed to be moved on, one of the shelters we work with stepped in to get as many of them out as possible before they ended up in the hands of other hunters.

Initially, TSPP with a couple of other rescues were able to help 17 of the dogs, but sadly, the hunter wouldn’t give us the other dogs at the time. A little further down the line, we were asked to help another eight of the Brittanys.

We quickly agreed knowing we didn’t want to risk losing the chance to help them again. Sadly, that number dropped to seven and then in the end was just four.

Thankfully, those four have now made it to the shelter and have the chance of a much better life, just like they have always deserved.

Ula is a lovely girl but it’s clear she’s had quite a sheltered life. She can be wary of strangers and can be very shy when she is approached.

When she’s let out into the outside area at the shelter though she really comes alive and loves running round, having a good leg stretch and taking in all the smells!

She shares a kennel with another Brittany from the same hunter, and they share their kennel and food really well without any issues.

Ula would do best in a quiet home without young children, and a friendly resident dog to show her the ropes! She can be cat tested for the right home.

name: Unique
description:
Unique is a medium Brittany, 2 years old.

Unique is one of 33 Brittanys who were kept together on a piece of land and used for hunting and showing.

When the land was put up for sale and the dogs needed to be moved on, one of the shelters we work with stepped in to get as many of them out as possible before they ended up in the hands of other hunters.

Initially, TSPP with a couple of other rescues were able to help 17 of the dogs, but sadly, the hunter wouldn’t give us the other dogs at the time.

A little further down the line, we were asked to help another eight of the Brittanys. We quickly agreed knowing we didn’t want to risk losing the chance to help them again.

Sadly, that number dropped to seven and then in the end was just four. Thankfully, those four have now made it to the shelter and have the chance of a much better life, just like they have always deserved.

Unique has a sweet and affectionate temperament and loves being with people, even though it’s clear she hasn’t had much human contact.

She is sociable with other dogs and currently shares a kennel with another Brittany. They get along very well, sharing their space and food without any issues.

Unique is an active girl and, when she’s let out into the outside area at the shelter, loves to run around and spend time sniffing the entire area!

She would do best in a quieter home without young children, and a friendly resident dog to help her gain confidence! She can be cat tested if needed.

name: Tiri
description:
Tiri is a handsome, large hound who was no longer wanted by his hunter. Happily for Tiri, he’s been taken in by one of the wonderful ladies in Spain and she’s covering his costs until he finds a new home.

Tiri is tall and elegant with a calm character. He’s good with other dogs that he’s met at the shelter, although they happen to have been females so far, so he’ll be introduced to some males in time as well.

He’s very affectionate with people and loves to run outside in the enclosed area of the shelter. He comes running when his name is called, although this could be very different on a fun walk!

Tiri can be a bit anxious around food at the moment which is understandable since many of these dogs haven’t had a plentiful supply of food before arriving at the shelter but, in time, he’ll learn that he doesn’t need to worry about where his next meal will come from.

name: Enrique
description:
Hello, my name is Enrique, and I’m a beautiful three-year-old Brittany Spaniel with a heart full of happiness and so much love to give.

Nobody really knows where I came from. One day, I found my way to the home of a rescue volunteer, walked inside as though I had always belonged there, and made it very clear that I did not want to leave.

Perhaps I simply knew I had finally found somewhere safe.

The volunteers tried hard to find my family, but sadly, nobody came looking for me. I did not have a microchip, so now I’m searching for something even better: a loving home where I will never feel unwanted again.

Everyone says my joy is contagious. I love people, affection and being included in everything. I’m desperate to be loved, but I have so much love to give in return.

I would happily live with other dogs, but I could also be your one and only, provided I receive plenty of companionship and attention.

Being a Brittany Spaniel, I would love an active home with someone who enjoys walks, adventures and exploring the world.
