I’m looking for a person or family who has time for me, who will include me in their life and who understands that, after finding my own way to safety, I deserve a home that will keep me forever.

I walked into the right house once. Now I’m hoping to walk into the right heart.

name: Livia
description:
We are looking for a calm, kind foster home for our beautiful girl, Livia, a 3 year old female Cross-Breed. Currently based in Wiltshire, U.K.

Livia had a tough start to life. She was sadly dumped outside our shelter in Bosnia. Thankfully, she was rescued and shown the love she deserves.

In January, Livia travelled to what we hoped would be her forever home in the UK. Unfortunately, one of her adopters has become seriously unwell and is currently in intensive care, leaving the remaining adopter struggling to manage her care.

This has been very hard on everyone, especially Livia.

We are now searching for a peaceful, understanding foster home where Livia can reset, decompress, and feel secure again.

If you can offer Livia the time, patience, and love she needs to heal and blossom, please reach out. She truly deserves a second chance at happiness.

name: Koko
description:
Koko is an approximately 10 months old setter/ pointer mix male located in Cheshire UK.

Super happy and handsome Koko is a medium height, rough coated, liver roan Setter x Pointer mix boy, an unusual mix! but a very nice combination and handsome looking boy with a very happy disposition.

He lives in foster in a multi dog situation and loves to play with them.

He’s an adorably sweet dog, very friendly, good on his lead, mixed in with our residents dogs well and just seems to love people. Koko has a cheerful happy demeanour.

Very attentive to people and likes fun with other dogs. Walks well on lead.

name: George
description:
George is a 2-year-1-month-old male Pointer cross Vizsla. He is an exuberant, intelligent, and boisterous young dog who is still settling in and being assessed. George is full of energy and thrives on both physical activity and mental challenges.

He is housetrained, travels well, and would love a secure garden where he can burn off energy and play. His active and clever nature means he will need adopters who can keep him engaged and stimulated daily.

Without enough to do, he may become restless.

George is confident, cuddly, and bouncy with adults. He enjoys affection but can be excitable, especially in new situations. He would do best with people who appreciate lively, working-breed types.

An adult-only home would be ideal, though he could live with sensible teenagers aged 14 and over who are used to large, energetic dogs.

George must be the only dog in the home. He is not suited to living with cats, small animals, or livestock due to his chasing instincts.

Adopters will need to understand the needs of his active breed mix and be ready to commit to ongoing training and structure. A home with previous experience of working breeds would be beneficial.

George would prefer a semi-rural or rural setting rather than a busy urban area.

name: Dexter
description:
Dexter is a 6 year old male German shepherd cross located in Spain.

This loveable chap is Dexter, a medium to large size, 6 year old, GSD mix who has a tan, short coat and black masked face.

Dexter is much smaller than a traditional GSD, as you can see by the videos and also the videos show how friendly he is and how popular in a group of dogs that live together.

Dexter is our priority, he’s not pretty or cute but he’s handsome and has a big, loving heart so we are desperate to help him find a new home.

Unfortunately, he is one of three dogs we are helping urgently, because he has had his ears cruelly cut, so it’s crucial we bring him to the UK as soon as possible before the laws change to ban dogs with cropped ears.

Dexter is great with male and female dogs and loves all people. He is quite independent and not the type of dog to want cuddles all of the time.

He has a fantastic character. He would not be good with cats due to how fixated he is with them. Children we think over 12 years.

Dexter has been tested as having low level Leish and is responding very well to his inexpensive treatment. A packet of tablets for one month is just £3 and of course Leish is not transferable to dogs or people.

Dexter is neutered, chipped, vaccinated, and has his passport, so he is ready to travel as soon as he is offered a foster place or an adoption. Dexter is a happy and playful chap and can also be calm and gentle. Good on lead.

name: Bilbo
description:
Calling all dog lovers – meet the very handsome Bilbo. Bilbo is a 5 year old male Spaniel Cross-Breed currently in Surrey, U.K., and he is looking for an adoptive or foster home.

Can live with a small dog after correct introductions.

Cat-free home, as he is not used to cats.

Bilbo is a 5 year old rescue boy who is searching for his forever (or foster) home. Currently located in Surrey, Bilbo likes his own space and will settle quite happily in his bed. He sleeps through the night and is calm and quiet.

Bilbo thrives in peaceful home environments and loves relaxing the most.

Bilbo is toilet trained, lead trained, and can be left for short periods in the house. He is non-destructive.

On walks, Bilbo shows lead frustration towards other dogs. He may pull and react out of frustration and fear. He shows no reaction towards people or strangers.

Bilbo is definitely food-motivated and will do anything for a tasty treat; this will help with his training going forward.

With correct introductions, Bilbo could live with another small dog, but he is still learning social cues and boundaries, so a patient canine companion would be ideal.

Bilbo could live with older, dog-savvy children of teenage age, as long as he has his own child-free space to go to. Bilbo likes his own space and does not like too much fuss when he is resting. He especially does not like being touched on the top of his head.

Rescue support in the U.K. Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue. Application and checks apply.

Vaccinated and blood tested.Flea and worm treated.Neutered and microchipped.

name: Minty
description:
Minty is a 6-year-old male Cross-Breed. He is described as a beautiful boy with a charming personality that has clearly helped him through some tough times. His affectionate and fun nature shines through in everything he does.

He previously spent six months in Lancram and narrowly escaped with his life, which makes his gentle and loving temperament even more special.

Despite his past, he has remained friendly and people-focused. He truly enjoys being around his humans and building a close bond.

Minty loves his walks and being outdoors, making him a great match for someone who enjoys an active lifestyle. Time spent exploring the outside world is one of his favourite things. He is happiest when he can share these moments with his special person.

At home, Minty would prefer a situation where his keeper is around for much of the time. He forms strong attachments and thrives on companionship and routine. A household where he is not left alone for long periods would suit him best.

Although he can get along with other dogs while out on walks, Minty would like to be the only dog in the home. He enjoys social moments outside but prefers a calm and focused environment indoors.

Having his humans all to himself would help him feel settled and secure.

He would be an especially good match for a retired but active person who enjoys regular walks. Someone with time, patience, and affection to give would help him truly flourish. In return, Minty offers loyalty, warmth, and plenty of loving companionship.

Minty is neutered, immunised, microchipped, and has been treated for fleas and worms. He has also been blood tested for Brucella canis and comes with a Romanian passport. A home check and adoption fee will apply as part of the adoption process.
